

======================================================================
ФАЙЛ: communities-backup-chat.js
======================================================================
(function () {
  function mk(tag, text, cls) {
    const e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (text !== undefined) e.textContent = text;
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    return e;
  }

  let cache = [];
  async function getCommunities() {
    const r = await fetch('/api/communities');
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    cache = await r.json();
    return cache;
  }

  function postCard(post) {
    const card = mk('div', undefined, 'game-card feed-item');
    card.append(
      mk('small', 'Автор: ' + (post.author || 'Автор неизвестен')),
      mk('h2', post.title || 'Публикация'),
      mk('p', post.body || ''),
      mk('small', post.created_at || '')
    );
    return card;
  }

  function goCreate() {
    const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a'));
    const btn = items.find(b => /^\+?\s*Создать$/.test(b.textContent.trim()));
    if (btn) btn.click(); else window.showScreen('Создать');
  }

  function communityCard(c) {
    const card = mk('div', undefined, 'game-card');
    const open = mk('button', 'Открыть');
    open.onclick = () => window.openCommunity(c.slug);
    card.append(mk('h2', c.name), mk('p', c.description || ''), open);
    return card;
  }

  async function renderCommunitiesScreen() {
    const main = document.querySelector('main');
    if (!main) return;
    main.replaceChildren(mk('h1', 'Сообщества'), mk('p', 'Находи людей с похожими интересами.'));
    try {
      const list = await getCommunities();
      list.forEach(c => main.append(communityCard(c)));
    } catch (e) {
      main.append(mk('p', 'Не удалось загрузить сообщества.'));
    }
  }

  window.renderCommunitiesScreen = renderCommunitiesScreen;
  window.openCommunity = async function (slug) {
    const main = document.querySelector('main');
    if (!main) return;
    main.replaceChildren(mk('p', 'Загружаю...'));
    try {
      const list = await getCommunities();
      const c = list.find(x => x.slug === slug);
      if (!c) throw new Error('нет такого сообщества');
      const r = await fetch('/api/posts?community=' + encodeURIComponent(slug));
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
      const posts = await r.json();

      main.replaceChildren();
      const back = mk('button', '← Все сообщества');
      back.onclick = () => window.renderCommunitiesScreen();
      const write = mk('button', '+ Написать здесь');
      write.onclick = () => { window.rebunarPreselect = c.id; goCreate(); };
      main.append(back, mk('h1', c.name), mk('p', c.description || ''), write);

      if (!posts.length) {
        main.append(mk('p', 'Здесь пока пусто. Напиши первую публикацию!'));
      }
      posts.forEach(post => main.append(postCard(post)));
    } catch (e) {
      main.replaceChildren(mk('p', 'Не удалось открыть сообщество.'));
    }
  };

  const prevShow = window.showScreen;
  window.showScreen = function (name) {
    if (String(name).includes('Сообщества')) {
      renderCommunitiesScreen();
      return;
    }
    return prevShow(name);
  };

  window.loadHomeCommunities = async function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('communityList');
    if (!box) return;
    try {
      const list = await getCommunities();
      box.replaceChildren();
      list.forEach(c => box.append(communityCard(c)));
    } catch (e) {
      box.textContent = 'Не удалось загрузить сообщества.';
    }
  };

  async function addSelect(titleInput) {
    const sel = document.createElement('select');
    sel.id = 'communitySelect';
    sel.style.cssText = 'width:100%;padding:12px;margin-bottom:12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:16px;';
    sel.append(new Option('Без сообщества', ''));
    titleInput.parentNode.insertBefore(sel, titleInput);
    try {
      const list = cache.length ? cache : await getCommunities();
      list.forEach(c => sel.append(new Option(c.name, String(c.id))));
      if (window.rebunarPreselect) {
        sel.value = String(window.rebunarPreselect);
        window.rebunarPreselect = null;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  new MutationObserver(() => {
    const t = document.getElementById('postTitle');
    if (t && !document.getElementById('communitySelect')) addSelect(t);
  }).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  window.publishPost = async function () {
    const titleInput = document.getElementById('postTitle');
    const textInput = document.getElementById('postText');
    const status = document.getElementById('postStatus');
    const sel = document.getElementById('communitySelect');
    if (!titleInput || !textInput || !status) return;

    const title = titleInput.value.trim();
    const text = textInput.value.trim();
    if (!title && !text) {
      status.textContent = 'Сначала напиши что-нибудь.';
      return;
    }
    const community_id = sel && sel.value ? Number(sel.value) : null;
    status.textContent = 'Сохраняю публикацию...';

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/posts', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ title, text, community_id })
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || 'Ошибка сохранения');
      titleInput.value = '';
      textInput.value = '';
      status.textContent = 'Публикация сохранена!';
    } catch (e) {
      status.textContent = e.message;
    }
  };

  window.loadHomeCommunities();
})();

document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
  const el = e.target.closest('nav span');
  if (el && el.textContent.includes('Сообщества')) {
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    e.preventDefault();
    window.renderCommunitiesScreen();
  }
}, true);

(function () {
  const baseOpen = window.openCommunity;
  window.openCommunity = async function (slug) {
    await baseOpen(slug);
    const main = document.querySelector('main');
    const h1 = main && main.querySelector('h1');
    if (!h1) return;

    const bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.style.cssText = 'margin:12px 0;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;';
    const info = document.createElement('small');
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    bar.append(info, btn);
    h1.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', bar);

    function paint(d) {
      info.textContent = 'Участников: ' + d.count;
      btn.textContent = d.joined ? 'Выйти из сообщества' : 'Вступить';
      btn.onclick = async () => {
        btn.disabled = true;
        try {
          const r = await fetch('/api/' + (d.joined ? 'leave/' : 'join/') + slug, { method: 'POST' });
          const j = await r.json();
          if (!r.ok) { info.textContent = j.error || 'Ошибка'; }
          else { paint(j); }
        } catch (e) {
          info.textContent = 'Нет связи с сервером';
        }
        btn.disabled = false;
      };
    }

    try {
      const r = await fetch('/api/membership/' + encodeURIComponent(slug));
      paint(await r.json());
    } catch (e) {
      info.textContent = '';
    }
  };
})();

document.head.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('style'), {textContent: 'main{padding-bottom:120px !important}'}));

document.head.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('style'), {textContent: 'nav, nav *{-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;-webkit-touch-callout:none;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}'}));

// --- ЛОГИКА ЛИЧНЫХ ЧАТОВ REBUNAR ---
let chatRefreshInterval = null;

window.openDirectChat = function (chatWithId, username) {
    const main = document.querySelector('main');
    if (!main) return;

    if (chatRefreshInterval) clearInterval(chatRefreshInterval);
    main.innerHTML = '';

    const header = document.createElement('div');
    header.style.cssText = 'display:flex; align-items:center; gap:15px; margin-bottom:15px; border-bottom:1px solid #333; padding-bottom:10px;';
    
    const backBtn = document.createElement('button');
    backBtn.textContent = '← Назад';
    backBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:6px 12px; background:#333; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px;';
    backBtn.onclick = () => { 
        clearInterval(chatRefreshInterval); 
        location.reload(); 
    };

    const title = document.createElement('h2');
    title.textContent = 'Чат с ' + username;
    title.style.cssText = 'margin:0; font-size:18px; color:#fff;';
    header.append(backBtn, title);

    const msgContainer = document.createElement('div');
    msgContainer.style.cssText = 'height:55vh; overflow-y:auto; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; padding:10px; background:#11111b; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:15px; border:1px solid #222;';

    const inputArea = document.createElement('div');
    inputArea.style.styleText = 'display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center;';

    const inputField = document.createElement('input');
    inputField.type = 'text';
    inputField.placeholder = 'Напишите сообщение...';
    inputField.style.cssText = 'flex-grow:1; padding:12px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #333; background:#1e1e2e; color:#fff; font-size:14px;';

    const sendBtn = document.createElement('button');
    sendBtn.textContent = 'Отправить';
    sendBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:12px 18px; background:#5865f2; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;';

    inputArea.append(inputField, sendBtn);
    main.append(header, msgContainer, inputArea);

    async function fetchChatHistory() {
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/messages/history?chat_with_id=' + chatWithId);
            if (!res.ok) return;
            const history = await res.json();
            
            if (msgContainer.children.length !== history.length) {
                msgContainer.innerHTML = '';
                history.forEach(msg => {
                    const block = document.createElement('div');
                    if (msg.sender_id === chatWithId) {
                        block.style.cssText = 'align-self: flex-start; background: #2a2a3a; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px 12px 12px 0px; max-width: 75%; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; word-break: break-word;';
                    } else {
                        block.style.cssText = 'align-self: flex-end; background: #5865f2; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px 12px 0px 12px; max-width: 75%; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; word-break: break-word;';
                    }
                    block.textContent = msg.text;
                    msgContainer.append(block);
                });
                msgContainer.scrollTop = msgContainer.scrollHeight;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Ошибка обновления сообщений:', err);
        }
    }

    async function handleSendMessage() {
        const messageText = inputField.value.trim();
        if (!messageText) return;
        sendBtn.disabled = true;

        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/messages/send', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ receiver_id: chatWithId, text: messageText })
            });
            if (res.ok) {
                inputField.value = '';
                await fetchChatHistory();
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Ошибка при отправке:', err);
        }
        sendBtn.disabled = false;
    }

    sendBtn.onclick = handleSendMessage;
    inputField.onkeydown = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSendMessage(); };

    fetchChatHistory();
    chatRefreshInterval = setInterval(fetchChatHistory, 3000);
};

(function () {
  function mk(tag, text, cls) {
    const e = document.createElement(tag);
    if (text !== undefined) e.textContent = text;
    if (cls) e.className = cls;
    return e;
  }

  let cache = [];
  async function getCommunities() {
    const r = await fetch('/api/communities');
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
    cache = await r.json();
    return cache;
  }

  function postCard(post) {
    const card = mk('div', undefined, 'game-card feed-item');
    card.append(
      mk('small', 'Автор: ' + (post.author || 'Автор неизвестен')),
      mk('h2', post.title || 'Публикация'),
      mk('p', post.body || ''),
      mk('small', post.created_at || '')
    );
    return card;
  }

  function goCreate() {
    const items = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a'));
    const btn = items.find(b => /^\+?\s*Создать$/.test(b.textContent.trim()));
    if (btn) btn.click(); else window.showScreen('Создать');
  }

  function communityCard(c) {
    const card = mk('div', undefined, 'game-card');
    const open = mk('button', 'Открыть');
    open.onclick = () => window.openCommunity(c.slug);
    card.append(mk('h2', c.name), mk('p', c.description || ''), open);
    return card;
  }

  async function renderCommunitiesScreen() {
    const main = document.querySelector('main');
    if (!main) return;
    main.replaceChildren(mk('h1', 'Сообщества'), mk('p', 'Находи людей с похожими интересами.'));
    try {
      const list = await getCommunities();
      list.forEach(c => main.append(communityCard(c)));
    } catch (e) {
      main.append(mk('p', 'Не удалось загрузить сообщества.'));
    }
  }

  window.renderCommunitiesScreen = renderCommunitiesScreen;
  window.openCommunity = async function (slug) {
    const main = document.querySelector('main');
    if (!main) return;
    main.replaceChildren(mk('p', 'Загружаю...'));
    try {
      const list = await getCommunities();
      const c = list.find(x => x.slug === slug);
      if (!c) throw new Error('нет такого сообщества');
      const r = await fetch('/api/posts?community=' + encodeURIComponent(slug));
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
      const posts = await r.json();

      main.replaceChildren();
      const back = mk('button', '← Все сообщества');
      back.onclick = () => window.renderCommunitiesScreen();
      const write = mk('button', '+ Написать здесь');
      write.onclick = () => { window.rebunarPreselect = c.id; goCreate(); };
      main.append(back, mk('h1', c.name), mk('p', c.description || ''), write);

      if (!posts.length) {
        main.append(mk('p', 'Здесь пока пусто. Напиши первую публикацию!'));
      }
      posts.forEach(post => main.append(postCard(post)));
    } catch (e) {
      main.replaceChildren(mk('p', 'Не удалось открыть сообщество.'));
    }
  };

  const prevShow = window.showScreen;
  window.showScreen = function (name) {
    if (String(name).includes('Сообщества')) {
      renderCommunitiesScreen();
      return;
    }
    return prevShow(name);
  };

  window.loadHomeCommunities = async function () {
    const box = document.getElementById('communityList');
    if (!box) return;
    try {
      const list = await getCommunities();
      box.replaceChildren();
      list.forEach(c => box.append(communityCard(c)));
    } catch (e) {
      box.textContent = 'Не удалось загрузить сообщества.';
    }
  };

  async function addSelect(titleInput) {
    const sel = document.createElement('select');
    sel.id = 'communitySelect';
    sel.style.cssText = 'width:100%;padding:12px;margin-bottom:12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:16px;';
    sel.append(new Option('Без сообщества', ''));
    titleInput.parentNode.insertBefore(sel, titleInput);
    try {
      const list = cache.length ? cache : await getCommunities();
      list.forEach(c => sel.append(new Option(c.name, String(c.id))));
      if (window.rebunarPreselect) {
        sel.value = String(window.rebunarPreselect);
        window.rebunarPreselect = null;
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  new MutationObserver(() => {
    const t = document.getElementById('postTitle');
    if (t && !document.getElementById('communitySelect')) addSelect(t);
  }).observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });

  window.publishPost = async function () {
    const titleInput = document.getElementById('postTitle');
    const textInput = document.getElementById('postText');
    const status = document.getElementById('postStatus');
    const sel = document.getElementById('communitySelect');
    if (!titleInput || !textInput || !status) return;

    const title = titleInput.value.trim();
    const text = textInput.value.trim();
    if (!title && !text) {
      status.textContent = 'Сначала напиши что-нибудь.';
      return;
    }
    const community_id = sel && sel.value ? Number(sel.value) : null;
    status.textContent = 'Сохраняю публикацию...';

    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/posts', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ title, text, community_id })
      });
      const result = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || 'Ошибка сохранения');
      titleInput.value = '';
      textInput.value = '';
      status.textContent = 'Публикация сохранена!';
    } catch (e) {
      status.textContent = e.message;
    }
  };

  window.loadHomeCommunities();
})();

    }
  };

let chatRefreshInterval = null;

window.openDirectChat = function (chatWithId, username) {
    const main = document.querySelector('main');
    if (!main) return;

    if (chatRefreshInterval) clearInterval(chatRefreshInterval);
    main.innerHTML = '';

    const header = document.createElement('div');
    header.style.cssText = 'display:flex; align-items:center; gap:15px; margin-bottom:15px; border-bottom:1px solid #333; padding-bottom:10px;';
    
    const backBtn = document.createElement('button');
    backBtn.textContent = '← Назад';
    backBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:6px 12px; background:#333; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px;';
    backBtn.onclick = () => { 
        clearInterval(chatRefreshInterval); 
        location.reload(); 
    };

    const title = document.createElement('h2');
    title.textContent = 'Чат с ' + username;
    title.style.cssText = 'margin:0; font-size:18px; color:#fff;';
    header.append(backBtn, title);

    const msgContainer = document.createElement('div');
    msgContainer.style.cssText = 'height:55vh; overflow-y:auto; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; padding:10px; background:#11111b; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:15px; border:1px solid #222;';

    const inputArea = document.createElement('div');
    inputArea.style.cssText = 'display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center;';

    const inputField = document.createElement('input');
    inputField.type = 'text';
    inputField.placeholder = 'Напишите сообщение...';
    inputField.style.cssText = 'flex-grow:1; padding:12px; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #333; background:#1e1e2e; color:#fff; font-size:14px;';

    const sendBtn = document.createElement('button');
    sendBtn.textContent = 'Отправить';
    sendBtn.style.cssText = 'padding:12px 18px; background:#5865f2; color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:bold;';

    inputArea.append(inputField, sendBtn);
    main.append(header, msgContainer, inputArea);

    async function fetchChatHistory() {
        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/messages/history?chat_with_id=' + chatWithId);
            if (!res.ok) return;
            const history = await res.json();
            
            if (msgContainer.children.length !== history.length) {
                msgContainer.innerHTML = '';
                history.forEach(msg => {
                    const block = document.createElement('div');
                    if (msg.sender_id === chatWithId) {
                        block.style.cssText = 'align-self: flex-start; background: #2a2a3a; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px 12px 12px 0px; max-width: 75%; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; word-break: break-word;';
                    } else {
                        block.style.cssText = 'align-self: flex-end; background: #5865f2; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px 12px 0px 12px; max-width: 75%; color: #fff; font-size: 14px; word-break: break-word;';
                    }
                    block.textContent = msg.text;
                    msgContainer.append(block);
                });
                msgContainer.scrollTop = msgContainer.scrollHeight;
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Ошибка обновления сообщений:', err);
        }
    }

    async function handleSendMessage() {
        const messageText = inputField.value.trim();
        if (!messageText) return;
        sendBtn.disabled = true;

        try {
            const res = await fetch('/api/messages/send', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ receiver_id: chatWithId, text: messageText })
            });
            if (res.ok) {
                inputField.value = '';
                await fetchChatHistory();
            }
        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Ошибка при отправке:', err);
        }
        sendBtn.disabled = false;
    }

    sendBtn.onclick = handleSendMessage;
    inputField.onkeydown = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSendMessage(); };

    fetchChatHistory();
    chatRefreshInterval = setInterval(fetchChatHistory, 3000);
};

/**

import {
  registerRoute,
  navigate,
  initRouter,
  subscribeToRoute
} from './router.js';

import { createShell } from '../layout/shell.js';
import { initNavigation } from '../layout/navigation.js';
import {
  initializeAuth,
  getUser,
  clearUser
} from '../features/auth/session.js';

import { renderAuthScreen } from '../features/auth/view.js';
import { logout } from '../features/auth/api.js';
import { renderProfileScreen } from '../features/profile/view.js';
import { renderHomeScreen } from '../features/home/view.js';
import { renderMessagesScreen } from '../features/messages/view.js';
import '../features/messages/messages.css';
import { renderStatisticsScreen } from '../features/statistics/view.js';
import { renderSettingsScreen } from '../features/settings/view.js';
import { startPresence, stopPresence } from '../features/statistics/presence.js';
import { initializeTheme } from '../shared/theme.js';
import {
  completeMatrixConnection
} from '../infrastructure/matrix/connection.js';
import {
  consumeMatrixSsoCallback
} from '../infrastructure/matrix/sso.js';
import {
  disconnectMatrix
} from '../infrastructure/matrix/client.js';

const root = document.getElementById('app');

if (!root) {
  throw new Error('Rebunar: элемент #app не найден');
}

const screens = {
  home: 'Главная',
  games: 'Игры',
  communities: 'Сообщества',
  messages: 'Сообщения',
  profile: 'Профиль',
  search: 'Поиск',
  notifications: 'Уведомления',
  composer: 'Создание публикации',
  settings: 'Настройки',
  statistics: 'Статистика'
};

for (const [path, title] of Object.entries(screens)) {
  registerRoute(path, () => {
    const outlet = document.getElementById('screen-outlet');

    if (!outlet) return;

    if (path === 'home') {
      renderHomeScreen(outlet);
      return;
    }

    if (path === 'messages') {
      renderMessagesScreen(outlet);
      return;
    }

    if (path === 'profile') {
      renderProfileScreen(outlet, getUser(), handleLogout);
      return;
    }

    if (path === 'settings') {
      renderSettingsScreen(outlet);
      return;
    }

    if (path === 'statistics') {
      renderStatisticsScreen(outlet);
      return;
    }

    outlet.innerHTML = `
      <section class="screen">
        <h1>${title}</h1>
        <p>Раздел Rebunar подготовлен к разработке.</p>
      </section>
    `;
  });
}

let appStarted = false;
let navigationInitialized = false;
let routerInitialized = false;

async function handleLogout(event) {
  const button = event?.currentTarget;
  stopPresence();

  if (button) {
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Выходим...';
  }

  try {
    await logout();

    try {
      await disconnectMatrix();
    } catch (matrixError) {
      console.warn('Rebunar: Matrix-соединение не удалось остановить');
    }

    clearUser();

    appStarted = false;

    renderAuthScreen(root, mountApp);

    console.log('Rebunar: выход из аккаунта выполнен');
  } catch (error) {
    startPresence();
    console.error('Rebunar: ошибка выхода:', error);

    if (button) {
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = 'Выйти из аккаунта';
    }

    const message = document.createElement('p');
    message.className = 'profile-logout-error';
    message.textContent = 'Не удалось выйти: ' + error.message;

    const card = root.querySelector('.profile-card');
    if (card) card.appendChild(message);
  }
}

function mountApp() {
  if (appStarted) return;

  appStarted = true;
  startPresence();

  createShell(root);

  if (!navigationInitialized) {
    initNavigation(root, navigate, subscribeToRoute);
    navigationInitialized = true;
  }

  const user = getUser();

  console.log(
    'Rebunar: пользователь авторизован:',
    user ? user.username : 'неизвестен'
  );

  if (!routerInitialized) {
    initRouter('home');
    routerInitialized = true;
  } else {
    navigate('home');
  }

  console.log('Rebunar: приложение запущено');
}

async function startApp() {
  root.innerHTML = `
    <section class="screen">
      <h1>Rebunar</h1>
      <p>Проверка подключения и авторизации...</p>
    </section>
  `;

  await initializeAuth();

  if (getUser()) {
    mountApp();

    if (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).has('loginToken')) {
      completeMatrixConnection().then(result => {
        if (result) {
          console.log('Rebunar: Matrix подключён, E2EE инициализирован');
        }
      }).catch(error => {
        console.error('Rebunar: ошибка подключения Matrix:', error.message);
      });
    }

    return;
  }

  // Если сессия Rebunar отсутствует, удаляем одноразовый
  // Matrix-токен из URL и предлагаем обычный вход.
  try {
    consumeMatrixSsoCallback();
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Rebunar: Matrix callback не принят');
  }

  renderAuthScreen(root, mountApp);

  console.log('Rebunar: ожидается вход пользователя');
}

initializeTheme();
startApp();

/**
 * REBUNAR — ROUTER
 * Единая система навигации приложения.
 */

const routes = new Map();
const listeners = new Set();

let currentRoute = null;

export function registerRoute(path, handler) {
  if (routes.has(path)) {
    throw new Error(`Маршрут уже зарегистрирован: ${path}`);
  }

  routes.set(path, handler);
}

export function navigate(path, params = {}) {
  const handler = routes.get(path);

  if (!handler) {
    console.error(`Маршрут не найден: ${path}`);
    return;
  }

  currentRoute = { path, params };

  window.history.pushState(currentRoute, '', `#${path}`);

  handler(params);

  listeners.forEach(listener => listener(currentRoute));
}

export function getCurrentRoute() {
  return currentRoute;
}

export function subscribeToRoute(listener) {
  listeners.add(listener);

  return () => listeners.delete(listener);
}

export function initRouter(defaultPath = 'home') {
  window.addEventListener('popstate', event => {
    const state = event.state;

    if (!state || !routes.has(state.path)) {
      navigate(defaultPath);
      return;
    }

    currentRoute = state;
    routes.get(state.path)(state.params || {});

    listeners.forEach(listener => listener(currentRoute));
  });

  const initialPath = window.location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/, '');

  if (initialPath && routes.has(initialPath)) {
    currentRoute = { path: initialPath, params: {} };
    routes.get(initialPath)({});
  } else {
    navigate(defaultPath);
  }
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — AUTH SESSION
 * Центральное состояние пользовательской сессии.
 */

import { getCurrentUser } from './api.js';

let currentUser = null;
let initialized = false;
const listeners = new Set();

export function getUser() {
  return currentUser;
}

export function isAuthenticated() {
  return Boolean(currentUser);
}

export function isAuthInitialized() {
  return initialized;
}

export function subscribeToAuth(listener) {
  listeners.add(listener);

  return () => listeners.delete(listener);
}

function notify() {
  listeners.forEach(listener => listener(currentUser));
}

export async function initializeAuth() {
  try {
    const result = await getCurrentUser();

    currentUser = result.logged_in ? result : null;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Rebunar: ошибка проверки авторизации:', error);
    currentUser = null;
  } finally {
    initialized = true;
    notify();
  }

  return currentUser;
}

export function setUser(user) {
  currentUser = user;
  initialized = true;
  notify();
}

export function clearUser() {
  currentUser = null;
  initialized = true;
  notify();
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — AUTH VIEW
 * Экран входа и регистрации.
 */

import { login, register } from './api.js';
import { setUser } from './session.js';

export function renderAuthScreen(container, onSuccess = () => {}) {
  let mode = 'login';

  function render(message = '') {
    const isRegister = mode === 'register';

    container.innerHTML = `
      <section class="auth-screen">
        <div class="auth-card">
          <div class="auth-brand">REBUNAR</div>
          <h1>${isRegister ? 'Создание аккаунта' : 'С возвращением'}</h1>
          <p class="auth-description">
            ${isRegister
              ? 'Создай аккаунт и присоединяйся к сообществу.'
              : 'Войди в свой аккаунт Rebunar.'}
          </p>

          <form class="auth-form">
            <label for="auth-username">Логин</label>
            <input
              id="auth-username"
              name="username"
              type="text"
              minlength="3"
              maxlength="50"
              autocomplete="username"
              placeholder="Твой логин"
              required
            >

            <label for="auth-password">Пароль</label>
            <input
              id="auth-password"
              name="password"
              type="password"
              minlength="4"
              autocomplete="${isRegister ? 'new-password' : 'current-password'}"
              placeholder="Твой пароль"
              required
            >

            <p class="auth-message" aria-live="polite"></p>

            <button class="auth-submit" type="submit">
              ${isRegister ? 'Зарегистрироваться' : 'Войти'}
            </button>
          </form>

          <button class="auth-switch" type="button">
            ${isRegister
              ? 'Уже есть аккаунт? Войти'
              : 'Нет аккаунта? Зарегистрироваться'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    `;

    const form = container.querySelector('.auth-form');
    const messageElement = container.querySelector('.auth-message');
    const switchButton = container.querySelector('.auth-switch');

    messageElement.textContent = message;

    switchButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
      mode = mode === 'login' ? 'register' : 'login';
      render();
    });

    form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
      event.preventDefault();

      const username = form.elements.username.value.trim();
      const password = form.elements.password.value;
      const submitButton = form.querySelector('.auth-submit');

      submitButton.disabled = true;
      submitButton.textContent = 'Подождите...';
      messageElement.textContent = '';

      try {
        let user;

        if (mode === 'register') {
          await register(username, password);
          messageElement.textContent = 'Аккаунт создан. Выполняем вход...';
          user = await login(username, password);
        } else {
          user = await login(username, password);
        }

        setUser(user);
        onSuccess(user);
      } catch (error) {
        messageElement.textContent = error.message;
        submitButton.disabled = false;
        submitButton.textContent = isRegister
          ? 'Зарегистрироваться'
          : 'Войти';
      }
    });
  }

  render();
}

import { api } from '../../shared/api/client.js';

export function getChats() {
  return api.get('/messages/chats');
}

export function searchUsers(query) {
  return api.get(`/users/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`);
}

export function getChatHistory(userId) {
  return api.get(`/messages/history?chat_with_id=${encodeURIComponent(userId)}`);
}

export function sendMessage(receiverId, message) {
  return api.post('/messages/send', {
    receiver_id: Number(receiverId),
    text: message
  });
}

export function getSelfNotes() {
  return api.get('/messages/self');
}

export function createSelfNote(message) {
  return api.post('/messages/self', { text: message });
}

export function deleteSelfNote(noteId) {
  return api.delete(`/messages/self/${Number(noteId)}`);
}

import { getUser } from '../auth/session.js';
import {
  getChats,
  searchUsers,
  getChatHistory,
  sendMessage,
  getSelfNotes,
  createSelfNote,
  deleteSelfNote
} from './api.js';

let outletRef = null;
let activeChat = null;
let activeTab = 'chats';
let chats = [];
let notes = [];
let searchTimer = null;
let refreshTimer = null;
let screenToken = 0;
let screenController = null;

const escapeHTML = value => String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, char => ({
  '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;'
})[char]);

function showStatus(container, message) {
  container.innerHTML = `<div class="messages-status">${escapeHTML(message)}</div>`;
}

function renderChatList(filter = '') {
  const list = outletRef?.querySelector('[data-chat-list]');
  if (!list) return;

  const query = filter.trim().toLowerCase();
  const filtered = chats.filter(chat =>
    `${chat.display_name || ''} ${chat.username || ''}`.toLowerCase().includes(query)
  );

  list.innerHTML = filtered.length ? filtered.map(chat => {
    const name = chat.display_name || chat.username || 'Пользователь';
    const initial = escapeHTML(name.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'R');
    const avatar = chat.avatar
      ? `<img class="chat-avatar-image" src="${escapeHTML(chat.avatar)}" alt=""
             onerror="this.remove()">`
      : '';

    return `
      <button class="messages-room-item ${activeChat?.user_id === chat.user_id ? 'is-active' : ''}"
        data-open-chat="${chat.user_id}">
        <span class="chat-avatar">
          ${avatar}
          <span class="chat-avatar-initial">${initial}</span>
        </span>
        <span class="chat-preview-block">
          <span class="chat-row-top">
            <span class="messages-room-name">${escapeHTML(name)}</span>
            <time class="chat-time">${escapeHTML(chat.created_at || '')}</time>
          </span>
          <span class="messages-room-preview">${escapeHTML(chat.last_message || 'Начните переписку')}</span>
        </span>
      </button>
    `;
  }).join('') : '<div class="messages-status">Переписок пока нет</div>';
}

function renderMessages(messages) {
  const list = outletRef?.querySelector('[data-message-list]');
  if (!list) return;

  const myId = Number(getUser()?.id);

  list.innerHTML = messages.length ? messages.map(message => {
    const isOwn = Number(message.sender_id) === myId;
    const name = message.display_name || message.username || 'Пользователь';
    const initial = escapeHTML(
      name.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || 'R'
    );

    const avatar = message.avatar
      ? `<img
           class="message-avatar-image"
           src="${escapeHTML(message.avatar)}"
           alt=""
           onerror="this.remove()"
         >`
      : '';

    return `
      <div class="message-row ${isOwn ? 'is-own' : 'is-incoming'}">
        <span class="message-avatar" aria-hidden="true">
          ${avatar}
          <span class="message-avatar-initial">${initial}</span>
        </span>

        <div class="messages-bubble">
          <div class="message-author">${escapeHTML(name)}</div>
          <div>${escapeHTML(message.text)}</div>
          <time>${escapeHTML(message.created_at || '')}</time>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('') : '<div class="messages-status">Начните переписку первым сообщением</div>';

  list.scrollTop = list.scrollHeight;
}

async function loadChats() {
  chats = await getChats();
  renderChatList(outletRef?.querySelector('[data-chat-search]')?.value || '');
}

async function openChat(user) {
  activeChat = user;
  renderChatList(outletRef?.querySelector('[data-chat-search]')?.value || '');

  const conversation = outletRef?.querySelector('[data-conversation]');
  if (!conversation) return;

  conversation.innerHTML = `
    <header class="messages-chat-header">
      <button class="messages-back" data-back>←</button>
      <div class="messages-room-name">${escapeHTML(user.display_name)}</div>
    </header>
    <div class="messages-message-list" data-message-list></div>
    <form class="messages-compose" data-send-form>
      <input name="text" maxlength="5000" placeholder="Написать сообщение..." autocomplete="off" required>
      <button type="submit">Отправить</button>
    </form>
  `;

  outletRef.querySelector('.messages-layout')?.classList.add('is-chat-open');

  try {
    renderMessages(await getChatHistory(user.user_id));
  } catch (error) {
    showStatus(conversation.querySelector('[data-message-list]'), error.message);
  }
}

async function loadNotes() {
  const area = outletRef?.querySelector('[data-notes]');
  if (!area) return;

  try {
    notes = await getSelfNotes();
    area.innerHTML = `
      <form class="messages-note-form" data-note-form>
        <textarea name="text" maxlength="5000" placeholder="Запиши свою мысль..." required></textarea>
        <button type="submit">Сохранить заметку</button>
      </form>
      <div class="messages-note-list">
        ${notes.length ? notes.map(note => `
          <article class="messages-note">
            <p>${escapeHTML(note.text)}</p>
            <time>${escapeHTML(note.created_at || '')}</time>
            <button data-delete-note="${note.id}">Удалить</button>
          </article>
        `).join('') : '<div class="messages-status">Заметок пока нет</div>'}
      </div>
    `;
  } catch (error) {
    showStatus(area, error.message);
  }
}

function renderShell() {
  outletRef.innerHTML = `
    <section class="screen messages-screen">
      <header class="messages-header">
        <div>
          <span class="messages-eyebrow">REBUNAR / PRIVATE SPACE</span>
          <h1>Чаты</h1>
          <p>Переписки и личные заметки</p>
        </div>
      </header>

      <nav class="messages-tabs">
        <button data-tab="chats" class="is-active">Чаты</button>
        <button data-tab="notes">Мои заметки</button>
      </nav>

      <div class="messages-layout">
        <aside class="messages-sidebar">
          <div class="messages-search">
            <input data-chat-search type="search" placeholder="Поиск переписок и людей...">
          </div>
          <div data-search-results></div>
          <div data-chat-list></div>
        </aside>
        <section class="messages-conversation" data-conversation>
          <div class="messages-placeholder">
            <span class="messages-placeholder-icon">◉</span>
            <h2>Твоё пространство общения</h2>
            <p>Выбери переписку или найди пользователя.</p>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>

      <section class="messages-notes-panel" data-notes hidden></section>
    </section>
  `;
}

export function renderMessagesScreen(outlet) {
  outletRef = outlet;
  activeChat = null;
  activeTab = 'chats';
  const token = ++screenToken;

  clearInterval(refreshTimer);
  clearTimeout(searchTimer);
  screenController?.abort();
  screenController = new AbortController();
  const listenerOptions = { signal: screenController.signal };

  renderShell();

  const search = outlet.querySelector('[data-chat-search]');

  search.addEventListener('input', () => {
    clearTimeout(searchTimer);
    const query = search.value.trim();
    renderChatList(query);

    if (!query) {
      outlet.querySelector('[data-search-results]').innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    searchTimer = setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const users = await searchUsers(query);
        if (token !== screenToken) return;
        const results = outlet.querySelector('[data-search-results]');
        if (!results) return;

        results.innerHTML = users.map(user => `
          <button class="messages-room-item" data-search-user="${user.id}">
            <span class="messages-room-name">${escapeHTML(user.display_name)}</span>
            <span class="messages-room-preview">@${escapeHTML(user.username)}</span>
          </button>
        `).join('');
      } catch (error) {
        showStatus(outlet.querySelector('[data-search-results]'), error.message);
      }
    }, 300);
  }, listenerOptions);

  outlet.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const tab = event.target.closest('[data-tab]');
    if (tab) {
      activeTab = tab.dataset.tab;
      outlet.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]').forEach(button =>
        button.classList.toggle('is-active', button === tab)
      );
      outlet.querySelector('.messages-layout').hidden = activeTab !== 'chats';
      outlet.querySelector('[data-notes]').hidden = activeTab !== 'notes';
      if (activeTab === 'notes') await loadNotes();
      return;
    }

    const chatButton = event.target.closest('[data-open-chat]');
    const userButton = event.target.closest('[data-search-user]');
    if (chatButton || userButton) {
      const id = Number(chatButton?.dataset.openChat || userButton?.dataset.searchUser);
      const user = chats.find(item => item.user_id === id) ||
        (userButton ? { user_id: id, display_name: userButton.querySelector('.messages-room-name').textContent } : null);
      if (user) await openChat(user);
      return;
    }

    if (event.target.closest('[data-back]')) {
      outlet.querySelector('.messages-layout').classList.remove('is-chat-open');
      activeChat = null;
      return;
    }

    const deleteButton = event.target.closest('[data-delete-note]');
    if (deleteButton) {
      try {
        await deleteSelfNote(deleteButton.dataset.deleteNote);
        await loadNotes();
      } catch (error) {
        alert(error.message);
      }
    }
  }, listenerOptions);

  outlet.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    if (event.target.matches('[data-send-form]')) {
      event.preventDefault();
      const input = event.target.elements.text;
      const text = input.value.trim();
      if (!text || !activeChat) return;

      const button = event.target.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
      button.disabled = true;
      try {
        await sendMessage(activeChat.user_id, text);
        input.value = '';
        renderMessages(await getChatHistory(activeChat.user_id));
        await loadChats();
      } catch (error) {
        alert(error.message);
      } finally {
        button.disabled = false;
      }
    }

    if (event.target.matches('[data-note-form]')) {
      event.preventDefault();
      const input = event.target.elements.text;
      const text = input.value.trim();
      if (!text) return;
      try {
        await createSelfNote(text);
        await loadNotes();
      } catch (error) {
        alert(error.message);
      }
    }
  }, listenerOptions);

  loadChats().catch(error => showStatus(outlet.querySelector('[data-chat-list]'), error.message));

  refreshTimer = setInterval(async () => {
    if (token !== screenToken) return;
    try {
      await loadChats();
      if (activeChat) renderMessages(await getChatHistory(activeChat.user_id));
    } catch {}
  }, 5000);
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — PROFILE API
 */

import { api } from '../../shared/api/client.js';

export async function uploadAvatar(blob) {
  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append('avatar', blob, 'avatar.jpg');

  return api.post('/profile/avatar', formData);
}

export async function updateProfile(username, displayName, bio) {
  return api.post('/profile', {
    username,
    display_name: displayName,
    bio
  });
}

export async function changePassword(currentPassword, newPassword) {
  return api.post('/security/password', {
    current_password: currentPassword,
    new_password: newPassword
  });
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — PROFILE VIEW
 */

import { uploadAvatar, updateProfile } from './api.js';
import { setUser } from '../auth/session.js';

export function renderProfileScreen(container, user, onLogout) {
  const avatar = user.avatar
    ? `<img class="profile-avatar-image" src="${escapeHTML(user.avatar)}" alt="Аватар">`
    : `<div class="profile-avatar-placeholder">R</div>`;

  const displayName = user.display_name || user.username || 'Пользователь';
  const username = user.username || '—';
  const hasUserId = user.id !== undefined && user.id !== null;
  const userId = hasUserId ? String(user.id) : '—';
  const bio = user.bio || 'Пока нет описания профиля.';

  container.innerHTML = `
    <section class="screen profile-screen">
      <div class="profile-heading">
        <button class="screen-back" type="button" data-route="settings"
          aria-label="Назад к настройкам" title="Назад к настройкам">
          <span aria-hidden="true">⤺</span>
        </button>
        <h1>Профиль</h1>
        <span class="profile-status">Публичный профиль</span>
      </div>

      <div class="profile-card">
        <button class="profile-avatar profile-avatar-button"
          type="button" aria-label="Аватар профиля">
          ${avatar}
        </button>

        <input class="profile-avatar-input" type="file"
          accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" hidden>

        <div class="profile-account-id">
          <span>ID: ${escapeHTML(userId)}</span>
          <button class="profile-copy-id" type="button"
            aria-label="Скопировать ID" title="Скопировать ID"
            ${hasUserId ? '' : 'disabled'}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
              <rect x="8" y="8" width="12" height="12" rx="2"></rect>
              <path d="M16 8V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1H5a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h3"></path>
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div class="profile-identity">
          <h2>${escapeHTML(displayName)}</h2>
          <p class="profile-username">@${escapeHTML(username)}</p>
        </div>

        <div class="profile-details">
          <div class="profile-bio">
            <span>О себе</span>
            <p>${escapeHTML(bio)}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button class="profile-edit" type="button">
          Редактировать профиль
        </button>

        <button class="profile-logout" type="button">
          Выйти из аккаунта
        </button>
      </div>
    </section>
  `;

  container.querySelector('.profile-edit')
    .addEventListener('click', () => {
      openProfileEditor(container, user, onLogout);
    });

  container.querySelector('.profile-logout')
    .addEventListener('click', onLogout);

  container.querySelector('.profile-copy-id')
    .addEventListener('click', async (event) => {
      const button = event.currentTarget;

      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(userId);
        button.textContent = '✓';
        button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'ID скопирован');
        button.title = 'ID скопирован';
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Rebunar: не удалось скопировать ID:', error);
        button.title = 'Не удалось скопировать ID';
      }
    });

  const avatarButton = container.querySelector('.profile-avatar-button');
  const fileInput = container.querySelector('.profile-avatar-input');

  avatarButton.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click());

  fileInput.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const file = fileInput.files?.[0];
    if (file) openAvatarEditor(container, file, user, onLogout);
    fileInput.value = '';
  });
}


function openProfileEditor(container, user, onLogout) {
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'profile-editor-overlay';

  const currentDisplayName = user.display_name || '';
  const currentUsername = user.username || '';
  const currentBio = user.bio || '';

  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div class="profile-editor" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="profile-editor-title">

      <div class="profile-editor-heading">
        <h2 id="profile-editor-title">Редактирование профиля</h2>
        <button class="profile-editor-close" type="button"
          aria-label="Закрыть">×</button>
      </div>

      <div class="profile-editor-fields">

        <label class="profile-editor-field">
          <span>Имя</span>
          <input
            class="profile-editor-display-name"
            type="text"
            maxlength="100"
            autocomplete="name"
            value="${escapeHTML(currentDisplayName)}"
            placeholder="Ваше имя">
        </label>

        <label class="profile-editor-field">
          <span>Имя пользователя</span>
          <div class="profile-editor-username-wrap">
            <span>@</span>
            <input
              class="profile-editor-username"
              type="text"
              maxlength="50"
              autocomplete="username"
              value="${escapeHTML(currentUsername)}"
              placeholder="username">
          </div>
          <small>Используется для входа в аккаунт.</small>
        </label>

        <label class="profile-editor-field">
          <span>О себе</span>
          <textarea
            class="profile-editor-bio"
            maxlength="500"
            rows="5"
            placeholder="Расскажите немного о себе">${escapeHTML(currentBio)}</textarea>
        </label>

      </div>

      <p class="profile-editor-error" aria-live="polite"></p>

      <div class="profile-editor-actions">
        <button class="profile-editor-cancel" type="button">
          Отмена
        </button>
        <button class="profile-editor-save" type="button">
          Сохранить
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  container.appendChild(overlay);

  const displayNameInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-display-name');
  const usernameInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-username');
  const bioInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-bio');
  const errorText =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-error');
  const saveButton =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-save');

  let saving = false;

  function closeEditor() {
    if (saving) return;
    overlay.remove();
  }

  overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-close')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-cancel')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === overlay) closeEditor();
  });

  saveButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (saving) return;

    const displayName = displayNameInput.value.trim();
    const username = usernameInput.value.trim().replace(/^@+/, '');
    const bio = bioInput.value.trim();

    if (username.length < 3) {
      errorText.textContent =
        'Имя пользователя должно содержать минимум 3 символа.';
      usernameInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    saving = true;
    saveButton.disabled = true;
    saveButton.textContent = 'Сохраняем...';
    errorText.textContent = '';

    try {
      const result = await updateProfile(
        username,
        displayName,
        bio
      );

      const updatedUser = {
        ...user,
        username: result.username,
        display_name: result.display_name,
        bio: result.bio
      };

      setUser(updatedUser);
      overlay.remove();

      renderProfileScreen(
        container,
        updatedUser,
        onLogout
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        'Rebunar: ошибка сохранения профиля:',
        error
      );

      errorText.textContent =
        error.message || 'Не удалось сохранить профиль';

      saving = false;
      saveButton.disabled = false;
      saveButton.textContent = 'Сохранить';
    }
  });

  displayNameInput.focus();
}

function openAvatarEditor(container, file, user, onLogout) {
  if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
    alert('Выберите фотографию в формате JPG, PNG или WebP.');
    return;
  }

  if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) {
    alert('Размер исходной фотографии не должен превышать 15 МБ.');
    return;
  }

  const imageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
  const image = new Image();

  image.onload = () => {
    createCropEditor(container, image, imageUrl, user, onLogout);
  };

  image.onerror = () => {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
    alert('Не удалось открыть эту фотографию.');
  };

  image.src = imageUrl;
}

function createCropEditor(container, image, imageUrl, user, onLogout) {
  const stageSize = 260;
  const baseScale = Math.max(
    stageSize / image.naturalWidth,
    stageSize / image.naturalHeight
  );

  let zoom = 1;
  let offsetX = 0;
  let offsetY = 0;
  let pointerX = 0;
  let pointerY = 0;
  let dragging = false;
  let saving = false;

  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'avatar-editor-overlay';

  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div class="avatar-editor" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="avatar-editor-title">
      <div class="avatar-editor-heading">
        <h2 id="avatar-editor-title">Настройка аватара</h2>
        <button class="avatar-editor-close" type="button"
          aria-label="Закрыть">×</button>
      </div>

      <div class="avatar-editor-stage">
        <img class="avatar-editor-image" alt="Предпросмотр аватара">
      </div>

      <p class="avatar-editor-hint">
        Перемещайте фото пальцем, чтобы выбрать нужную область
      </p>

      <label class="avatar-editor-zoom">
        <span>Масштаб</span>
        <input class="avatar-editor-range" type="range"
          min="1" max="3" step="0.01" value="1">
      </label>

      <p class="avatar-editor-error" aria-live="polite"></p>

      <div class="avatar-editor-actions">
        <button class="avatar-editor-cancel" type="button">Отмена</button>
        <button class="avatar-editor-save" type="button">Сохранить</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  container.appendChild(overlay);

  const stage = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-stage');
  const preview = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-image');
  const range = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-range');
  const saveButton = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-save');
  const errorText = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-error');

  preview.src = image.src;

  function clampPosition() {
    const width = image.naturalWidth * baseScale * zoom;
    const height = image.naturalHeight * baseScale * zoom;

    const maxX = Math.max(0, (width - stageSize) / 2);
    const maxY = Math.max(0, (height - stageSize) / 2);

    offsetX = Math.max(-maxX, Math.min(maxX, offsetX));
    offsetY = Math.max(-maxY, Math.min(maxY, offsetY));
  }

  function updatePreview() {
    clampPosition();

    const width = image.naturalWidth * baseScale * zoom;
    const height = image.naturalHeight * baseScale * zoom;

    preview.style.width = `${width}px`;
    preview.style.height = `${height}px`;
    preview.style.transform =
      `translate(calc(-50% + ${offsetX}px), calc(-50% + ${offsetY}px))`;
  }

  function closeEditor() {
    if (saving) return;
    overlay.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
  }

  overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-close')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-cancel')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === overlay) closeEditor();
  });

  range.addEventListener('input', () => {
    zoom = Number(range.value);
    updatePreview();
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
    dragging = true;
    pointerX = event.clientX;
    pointerY = event.clientY;
    stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
    if (!dragging) return;

    offsetX += event.clientX - pointerX;
    offsetY += event.clientY - pointerY;

    pointerX = event.clientX;
    pointerY = event.clientY;

    updatePreview();
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
    dragging = false;
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
    dragging = false;
  });

  saveButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (saving) return;

    saving = true;
    saveButton.disabled = true;
    saveButton.textContent = 'Сохраняем...';
    errorText.textContent = '';

    try {
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = 512;
      canvas.height = 512;

      const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
      if (!context) throw new Error('Не удалось подготовить изображение');

      const factor = 512 / stageSize;
      const width = image.naturalWidth * baseScale * zoom * factor;
      const height = image.naturalHeight * baseScale * zoom * factor;
      const x = (stageSize / 2 + offsetX) * factor - width / 2;
      const y = (stageSize / 2 + offsetY) * factor - height / 2;

      context.drawImage(image, x, y, width, height);

      const blob = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        canvas.toBlob(
          result => result
            ? resolve(result)
            : reject(new Error('Не удалось обработать фотографию')),
          'image/jpeg',
          0.9
        );
      });

      const result = await uploadAvatar(blob);

      if (!result.avatar) {
        throw new Error('Сервер не вернул адрес аватара');
      }

      setUser({ ...user, avatar: result.avatar });
      overlay.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);

      renderProfileScreen(container, { ...user, avatar: result.avatar },
        onLogout);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Rebunar: ошибка сохранения аватара:', error);
      errorText.textContent = error.message || 'Не удалось сохранить аватар';
      saving = false;
      saveButton.disabled = false;
      saveButton.textContent = 'Сохранить';
    }
  });

  updatePreview();
}

function escapeHTML(value) {
  return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    '"': '&quot;',
    "'": '&#039;'
  })[character]);
}

async function openMatrixEditor(outlet) {
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'security-editor-overlay';

  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div class="security-editor" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
      <div class="security-editor-heading">
        <h2>Matrix и E2EE</h2>
        <button class="security-editor-close" type="button" aria-label="Закрыть">×</button>
      </div>

      <p class="security-editor-description">
        Подключение Matrix для защищённого обмена сообщениями
        со сквозным шифрованием.
      </p>

      <div class="matrix-editor-status">Проверка подключения...</div>
      <p class="security-editor-error matrix-editor-error" role="alert"></p>

      <div class="security-editor-actions matrix-editor-actions">
        <button class="security-editor-save matrix-editor-connect" type="button">
          Подключить Matrix
        </button>
        <button class="security-editor-cancel matrix-editor-disconnect" type="button">
          Отвязать аккаунт
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  outlet.appendChild(overlay);

  const status = overlay.querySelector('.matrix-editor-status');
  const error = overlay.querySelector('.matrix-editor-error');
  const connectButton = overlay.querySelector('.matrix-editor-connect');
  const disconnectButton = overlay.querySelector('.matrix-editor-disconnect');

  function closeEditor() {
    overlay.remove();
  }

  overlay.querySelector('.security-editor-close')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === overlay) closeEditor();
  });

  async function refreshStatus() {
    status.textContent = 'Проверка подключения...';
    error.textContent = '';
    disconnectButton.hidden = true;

    try {
      const account = await getLinkedMatrixAccount();

      if (account.linked) {
        status.textContent = 'Подключён: ' + account.matrix_user_id;
        connectButton.hidden = false;
        connectButton.textContent = 'Переподключить Matrix';
        disconnectButton.hidden = false;
      } else {
        status.textContent = 'Matrix не подключён';
        connectButton.hidden = false;
        connectButton.textContent = 'Подключить Matrix';
        disconnectButton.hidden = true;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      status.textContent = 'Не удалось проверить подключение';
      error.textContent = err.message;
      connectButton.hidden = false;
    }
  }

  connectButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
    error.textContent = '';

    try {
      beginMatrixConnection();
    } catch (err) {
      error.textContent = err.message;
    }
  });

  disconnectButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    disconnectButton.disabled = true;
    error.textContent = '';

    try {
      await removeMatrixConnection();
      await refreshStatus();
    } catch (err) {
      error.textContent = err.message;
    } finally {
      disconnectButton.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  await refreshStatus();
}

function openSecurityEditor(outlet) {
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'security-editor-overlay';

  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div class="security-editor" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="security-editor-title">

      <div class="security-editor-heading">
        <h2 id="security-editor-title">Безопасность</h2>
        <button class="security-editor-close" type="button"
          aria-label="Закрыть">×</button>
      </div>

      <p class="security-editor-description">
        Измените пароль для входа в аккаунт Rebunar.
      </p>

      <div class="security-editor-fields">

        <label class="security-editor-field">
          <span>Текущий пароль</span>
          <input
            class="security-current-password"
            type="password"
            autocomplete="current-password"
            placeholder="Введите текущий пароль">
        </label>

        <label class="security-editor-field">
          <span>Новый пароль</span>
          <input
            class="security-new-password"
            type="password"
            autocomplete="new-password"
            minlength="4"
            placeholder="Минимум 4 символа">
        </label>

        <label class="security-editor-field">
          <span>Повтор нового пароля</span>
          <input
            class="security-confirm-password"
            type="password"
            autocomplete="new-password"
            minlength="4"
            placeholder="Повторите новый пароль">
        </label>

      </div>

      <p class="security-editor-error" aria-live="polite"></p>

      <div class="security-editor-actions">
        <button class="security-editor-cancel" type="button">
          Отмена
        </button>
        <button class="security-editor-save" type="button">
          Сохранить
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  outlet.appendChild(overlay);

  const currentInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.security-current-password');
  const newInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.security-new-password');
  const confirmInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.security-confirm-password');
  const errorText =
    overlay.querySelector('.security-editor-error');
  const saveButton =
    overlay.querySelector('.security-editor-save');

  let saving = false;

  function closeEditor() {
    if (saving) return;
    overlay.remove();
  }

  overlay.querySelector('.security-editor-close')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.querySelector('.security-editor-cancel')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === overlay) closeEditor();
  });

  saveButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (saving) return;

    const currentPassword = currentInput.value;
    const newPassword = newInput.value;
    const confirmPassword = confirmInput.value;

    errorText.textContent = '';

    if (!currentPassword) {
      errorText.textContent = 'Введите текущий пароль.';
      currentInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword.length < 4) {
      errorText.textContent =
        'Новый пароль должен содержать минимум 4 символа.';
      newInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      errorText.textContent =
        'Новые пароли не совпадают.';
      confirmInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    if (currentPassword === newPassword) {
      errorText.textContent =
        'Новый пароль должен отличаться от текущего.';
      newInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    saving = true;
    saveButton.disabled = true;
    saveButton.textContent = 'Сохраняем...';

    try {
      await changePassword(currentPassword, newPassword);

      currentInput.value = '';
      newInput.value = '';
      confirmInput.value = '';

      overlay.remove();

      alert('Пароль успешно изменён.');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        'Rebunar: ошибка смены пароля:',
        error
      );

      errorText.textContent =
        error.message || 'Не удалось изменить пароль';

      saving = false;
      saveButton.disabled = false;
      saveButton.textContent = 'Сохранить';
    }
  });

  currentInput.focus();
}

  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'appearance-editor-overlay';

  const currentTheme = getTheme();
  const themes = getThemes();

  overlay.innerHTML = `

      aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="appearance-editor-title">

      <div class="appearance-editor-heading">
        <div>
          <span class="appearance-editor-eyebrow">
            REBUNAR / APPEARANCE
          </span>
          <h2 id="appearance-editor-title">Оформление</h2>
        </div>

        <button class="appearance-editor-close"
          type="button" aria-label="Закрыть">×</button>
      </div>

      <div class="appearance-editor-section">
        <div class="appearance-editor-section-heading">
          <strong>Выбери свою тему</strong>
          <span>Шесть вариантов оформления Rebunar</span>
        </div>

        <div class="appearance-theme-options">
          ${Object.entries(themes).map(([key, theme]) => `
            <button
              class="appearance-theme-option ${currentTheme === key ? 'is-active' : ''}"
              type="button"
              data-theme="${key}">

              <span class="appearance-theme-preview appearance-theme-preview-${key}">
                <span></span>
                <span></span>
                <span></span>
              </span>

              <span class="appearance-theme-info">
                <strong>${theme.name}</strong>
                <small>${theme.description}</small>
              </span>

              <span class="appearance-theme-check">✓</span>
            </button>
          `).join('')}
        </div>
      </div>

      <p class="appearance-editor-note">
        Яркий изумруд установлен по умолчанию. Другие темы можно выбрать в любое время.
      </p>
    </div>
  `;

  outlet.appendChild(overlay);

  function closeEditor() {
    overlay.remove();
  }

  overlay.querySelector('.appearance-editor-close')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === overlay) {
      closeEditor();
    }
  });

  overlay.querySelectorAll('[data-theme]').forEach((button) => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const theme = button.dataset.theme;
      applyTheme(theme);

      overlay.querySelectorAll('[data-theme]').forEach((item) => {
        item.classList.toggle(
          'is-active',
          item.dataset.theme === theme
        );
      });
    });
  });
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — STATISTICS API
 * Получение публичной статистики платформы.
 */

import { api } from '../../shared/api/client.js';

export function getStatisticsSummary() {
  return api.get('/statistics/summary');
}

export function getStatisticsHistory(period = 'week') {
  const allowedPeriods = ['week', 'month', 'year'];

  if (!allowedPeriods.includes(period)) {
    throw new Error('Недопустимый период статистики');
  }

  return api.get(`/statistics/history?period=${period}`);
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — USER PRESENCE
 * Обновление активности авторизованного пользователя.
 */

import { api } from '../../shared/api/client.js';

let heartbeatTimer = null;

async function sendHeartbeat() {
  try {
    await api.post('/presence/heartbeat', {});
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Rebunar: не удалось обновить активность:', error.message);
  }
}

export function startPresence() {
  if (heartbeatTimer !== null) return;

  sendHeartbeat();
  heartbeatTimer = setInterval(sendHeartbeat, 60_000);
}

export function stopPresence() {
  if (heartbeatTimer !== null) {
    clearInterval(heartbeatTimer);
    heartbeatTimer = null;
  }
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — STATISTICS VIEW
 * Экран публичной статистики платформы.
 */

import {
  getStatisticsSummary,
  getStatisticsHistory
} from './api.js';

const PERIODS = {
  week: 'Неделя',
  month: 'Месяц',
  year: 'Год'
};

function formatDate(value, period) {
  const date = new Date(value + 'T00:00:00');

  if (period === 'year') {
    return date.toLocaleDateString('ru-RU', {
      month: 'short'
    });
  }

  return date.toLocaleDateString('ru-RU', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short'
  });
}

function createChart(registrations, period) {
  const width = 720;
  const height = 260;
  const padding = { top: 24, right: 24, bottom: 42, left: 42 };

  const innerWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
  const innerHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;

  const values = registrations.map(item => item.count);
  const maxValue = Math.max(1, ...values);
  const points = registrations.map((item, index) => {
    const x = padding.left +
      (registrations.length > 1
        ? index / (registrations.length - 1) * innerWidth
        : innerWidth / 2);

    const y = padding.top +
      innerHeight - item.count / maxValue * innerHeight;

    return {
      x,
      y,
      date: item.date,
      count: item.count
    };
  });

  const line = points
    .map((point, index) =>
      `${index === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'} ${point.x} ${point.y}`
    )
    .join(' ');

  const area = points.length
    ? `${line} L ${points[points.length - 1].x} ${padding.top + innerHeight} L ${points[0].x} ${padding.top + innerHeight} Z`
    : '';

  const grid = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(step => {
    const y = padding.top + innerHeight * step / 3;
    const value = Math.round(maxValue * (3 - step) / 3);

    return `
      <line x1="${padding.left}" y1="${y}"
            x2="${width - padding.right}" y2="${y}"
            class="statistics-grid-line"/>
      <text x="${padding.left - 10}" y="${y + 4}"
            text-anchor="end" class="statistics-axis-label">${value}</text>
    `;
  }).join('');

  const markers = points.map(point => `
    <circle cx="${point.x}" cy="${point.y}" r="4"
            class="statistics-point">
      <title>${point.date}: ${point.count}</title>
    </circle>
  `).join('');

  const labels = points
    .filter((point, index) =>
      index === 0 ||
      index === points.length - 1 ||
      (period === 'week' && index === Math.floor(points.length / 2)) ||
      (period !== 'week' && index % Math.ceil(points.length / 5) === 0)
    )
    .map(point => `
      <text x="${point.x}" y="${height - 12}"
            text-anchor="middle" class="statistics-axis-label">
        ${formatDate(point.date, period)}
      </text>
    `).join('');

  return `
    <svg class="statistics-chart" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}"
         role="img" aria-label="График регистраций">
      ${grid}
      ${area ? `<path d="${area}" class="statistics-area"/>` : ''}
      ${points.length > 1
        ? `<path d="${line}" class="statistics-line"/>`
        : ''}
      ${markers}
      ${labels}
    </svg>
  `;
}

export async function renderStatisticsScreen(outlet) {
  outlet.innerHTML = `
    <section class="screen statistics-screen">
      <div class="statistics-heading">
        <div>
          <button class="screen-back" type="button" data-route="settings" aria-label="Назад к настройкам" title="Назад к настройкам">
            <span aria-hidden="true">⤺</span>
          </button>
          <span class="statistics-eyebrow">REBUNAR / ANALYTICS</span>
          <h1>Статистика</h1>
          <p>Развитие и активность платформы</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="statistics-summary-grid">
        <article class="statistics-card">
          <span>Всего аккаунтов</span>
          <strong id="statistics-total">—</strong>
        </article>

        <article class="statistics-card">
          <span>Сейчас онлайн</span>
          <strong id="statistics-online">—</strong>
        </article>
      </div>

      <section class="statistics-chart-card">
        <div class="statistics-chart-header">
          <div>
            <h2>Рост регистраций</h2>
            <p id="statistics-period-total">Загрузка данных...</p>
          </div>

          <div class="statistics-periods">
            ${Object.entries(PERIODS).map(([key, label]) => `
              <button type="button"
                      data-statistics-period="${key}"
                      class="${key === 'week' ? 'is-active' : ''}">
                ${label}
              </button>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div id="statistics-chart-container"
             class="statistics-chart-container">
          <p>Загружаем график...</p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <p class="statistics-footnote">
        Данные обновляются с сервера Rebunar.
      </p>
    </section>
  `;

  const totalElement = outlet.querySelector('#statistics-total');
  const onlineElement = outlet.querySelector('#statistics-online');
  const periodTotal = outlet.querySelector('#statistics-period-total');
  const chartContainer = outlet.querySelector('#statistics-chart-container');
  const periodButtons = outlet.querySelectorAll('[data-statistics-period]');

  let selectedPeriod = 'week';
  let requestNumber = 0;

  async function loadPeriod(period) {
    selectedPeriod = period;
    const currentRequest = ++requestNumber;

    periodButtons.forEach(button => {
      button.classList.toggle(
        'is-active',
        button.dataset.statisticsPeriod === period
      );
    });

    chartContainer.innerHTML = '<p>Загружаем график...</p>';
    periodTotal.textContent = 'Загрузка данных...';

    try {
      const data = await getStatisticsHistory(period);

      if (currentRequest !== requestNumber) return;

      const registrations = data.registrations || [];
      const total = registrations.reduce(
        (sum, item) => sum + item.count,
        0
      );

      periodTotal.textContent = `${total} новых регистраций за период`;

      chartContainer.innerHTML = registrations.length
        ? createChart(registrations, period)
        : '<p class="statistics-empty">Пока нет регистраций за этот период.</p>';
    } catch (error) {
      if (currentRequest !== requestNumber) return;

      chartContainer.innerHTML =
        '<p class="statistics-error">Не удалось загрузить график.</p>';

      periodTotal.textContent = error.message;
    }
  }

  periodButtons.forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      loadPeriod(button.dataset.statisticsPeriod);
    });
  });

  try {
    const summary = await getStatisticsSummary();
    totalElement.textContent = summary.total_users ?? 0;
    onlineElement.textContent = summary.online_users ?? 0;
  } catch (error) {
    totalElement.textContent = '—';
    onlineElement.textContent = '—';
    console.error('Rebunar: ошибка статистики:', error);
  }

  await loadPeriod(selectedPeriod);
}

import { createClient } from 'matrix-js-sdk';

export async function verifyMatrixCredentials({
  baseUrl,
  userId,
  accessToken,
  deviceId
}) {
  if (!baseUrl || !accessToken) {
    throw new Error('Не хватает данных авторизации Matrix.');
  }

  const client = createClient({
    baseUrl,
    accessToken
  });

  try {
    const identity = await client.whoami();

    if (identity.is_guest) {
      throw new Error('Гостевой Matrix-аккаунт нельзя привязать.');
    }

    if (!identity.user_id || identity.user_id !== userId) {
      throw new Error('Matrix ID не совпадает с подтверждённым аккаунтом.');
    }

    if (deviceId && identity.device_id !== deviceId) {
      throw new Error('ID устройства Matrix не совпадает.');
    }

    return {
      userId: identity.user_id,
      deviceId: identity.device_id || deviceId || null
    };
  } finally {
    await client.stopClient();
  }
}
let matrixClient = null;
let syncReady = false;
let initializationPromise = null;

export function getMatrixClient() {
  return matrixClient;
}

export function isMatrixSyncReady() {
  return syncReady;
}

export async function initializeMatrix({
  baseUrl,
  userId,
  accessToken,
  deviceId
}) {
  if (initializationPromise) {
    return initializationPromise;
  }

  if (!baseUrl || !userId || !accessToken || !deviceId) {
    throw new Error('Для подключения Matrix не хватает параметров авторизации.');
  }

  initializationPromise = (async () => {
    const client = createClient({
      baseUrl,
      userId,
      accessToken,
      deviceId
    });

    const cryptoDatabasePrefix =
      'rebunar-' +
      encodeURIComponent(userId) +
      '-' +
      encodeURIComponent(deviceId);

    await client.initRustCrypto({ cryptoDatabasePrefix });

    matrixClient = client;

    const syncPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        cleanup();
        reject(new Error('Matrix не завершил начальную синхронизацию за 90 секунд.'));
      }, 90000);

      const cleanup = () => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        client.removeListener('sync', onSync);
      };

      const onSync = (state, previousState, data) => {
        if (state === 'PREPARED' || state === 'SYNCING') {
          cleanup();
          syncReady = true;
          resolve();
        } else if (state === 'ERROR') {
          const error = data?.error;
          const message = error?.message || 'Ошибка синхронизации Matrix';
          cleanup();
          reject(new Error(message));
        }
      };

      client.on('sync', onSync);
    });

    try {
      await client.startClient({ initialSyncLimit: 20 });
      await syncPromise;
      return client;
    } catch (error) {
      syncReady = false;
      matrixClient = null;
      await client.stopClient();
      throw error;
    }
  })();

  try {
    return await initializationPromise;
  } catch (error) {
    initializationPromise = null;
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function disconnectMatrix() {
  const client = matrixClient;

  matrixClient = null;
  syncReady = false;
  initializationPromise = null;

  if (client) {
    await client.stopClient();
  }
}
