/**
 * REBUNAR — MATRIX CONNECTION
 * Координация SSO, привязки аккаунта и E2EE.
 */

import {
  startMatrixSso,
  consumeMatrixSsoCallback,
  exchangeMatrixSsoToken
} from './sso.js';

import {
  getMatrixStatus,
  linkMatrixAccount,
  unlinkMatrixAccount
} from './api.js';

import {
  initializeMatrix,
  disconnectMatrix
} from './client.js';

const MATRIX_HOMESERVER = 'https://matrix.org';

export function beginMatrixConnection() {
  startMatrixSso();
}

export async function completeMatrixConnection() {
  const loginToken = consumeMatrixSsoCallback();

  if (!loginToken) return null;

  const credentials = await exchangeMatrixSsoToken(loginToken);

  const linkedAccount = await linkMatrixAccount({
    accessToken: credentials.accessToken,
    matrixUserId: credentials.userId,
    deviceId: credentials.deviceId
  });

  try {
    await initializeMatrix({
      baseUrl: MATRIX_HOMESERVER,
      userId: credentials.userId,
      accessToken: credentials.accessToken,
      deviceId: credentials.deviceId
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new Error(
      'Аккаунт Matrix привязан, но E2EE не удалось запустить: ' +
      error.message
    );
  }

  return {
    userId: linkedAccount.matrix_user_id,
    deviceId: linkedAccount.device_id
  };
}

export function getLinkedMatrixAccount() {
  return getMatrixStatus();
}

export async function removeMatrixConnection() {
  await unlinkMatrixAccount();
  await disconnectMatrix();
}

import { RoomEvent, MatrixEventEvent } from 'matrix-js-sdk';
import { getMatrixClient, isMatrixSyncReady } from './client.js';

function requireClient() {
  const client = getMatrixClient();

  if (!client || !isMatrixSyncReady()) {
    throw new Error('Matrix ещё не подключён или не завершил синхронизацию.');
  }

  return client;
}

function mapEvent(event) {
  const encrypted = event.isEncrypted();

  if (encrypted && event.isDecryptionFailure()) {
    return {
      id: event.getId(),
      sender: event.getSender(),
      body: 'Не удалось расшифровать это сообщение.',
      timestamp: event.getTs(),
      status: 'DECRYPTION_FAILED'
    };
  }

  const content = encrypted
    ? event.getClearContent()
    : event.getContent();

  if (!content || content.msgtype !== 'm.text') {
    return null;
  }

  if (!encrypted && event.getType() !== 'm.room.message') {
    return null;
  }

  if (typeof content.body !== 'string') {
    return null;
  }

  return {
    id: event.getId(),
    sender: event.getSender(),
    body: content.body,
    timestamp: event.getTs(),
    status: event.status || 'SENT'
  };
}

export function getMatrixRooms() {
  return requireClient()
    .getRooms()
    .filter(room => room.getMyMembership() === 'join')
    .map(room => ({
      id: room.roomId,
      name: room.name || room.roomId,
      unreadCount: room.getUnreadNotificationCount(),
      lastActivity: room.getLastActiveTimestamp()
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.lastActivity - a.lastActivity);
}

export function getMatrixRoomMessages(roomId) {
  const client = requireClient();
  const room = client.getRoom(roomId);

  if (!room || room.getMyMembership() !== 'join') {
    throw new Error('Комната не найдена или пользователь не состоит в ней.');
  }

  return room
    .getLiveTimeline()
    .getEvents()
    .map(mapEvent)
    .filter(Boolean);
}

export async function sendMatrixMessage(roomId, body) {
  const client = requireClient();
  const room = client.getRoom(roomId);
  const message = String(body || '').trim();

  if (!room || room.getMyMembership() !== 'join') {
    throw new Error('Комната не найдена или пользователь не состоит в ней.');
  }

  if (!message) {
    throw new Error('Нельзя отправить пустое сообщение.');
  }

  return client.sendMessage(roomId, {
    msgtype: 'm.text',
    body: message
  });
}

export function subscribeToMatrixMessages(roomId, callback) {
  const client = requireClient();

  if (typeof callback !== 'function') {
    throw new TypeError('Для подписки нужен callback.');
  }

  const room = client.getRoom(roomId);

  if (!room || room.getMyMembership() !== 'join') {
    throw new Error('Комната не найдена или пользователь не состоит в ней.');
  }

  const publishEvent = event => {
    const message = mapEvent(event);

    if (message) {
      callback(message);
    }
  };

  const onTimeline = (event, eventRoom, toStartOfTimeline, removed) => {
    if (eventRoom?.roomId !== roomId || toStartOfTimeline || removed) {
      return;
    }

    // Зашифрованные события получаем после расшифровки
    // через MatrixEventEvent.Decrypted на клиенте.
    if (event.isEncrypted()) {
      return;
    }

    publishEvent(event);
  };

  const onDecrypted = event => {
    if (event.getRoomId() !== roomId) {
      return;
    }

    publishEvent(event);
  };

  client.on(RoomEvent.Timeline, onTimeline);
  client.on(MatrixEventEvent.Decrypted, onDecrypted);

  return () => {
    client.removeListener(RoomEvent.Timeline, onTimeline);
    client.removeListener(MatrixEventEvent.Decrypted, onDecrypted);
  };
}

const historyRequests = new Map();

export async function loadOlderMatrixMessages(roomId, limit = 30) {
  const client = requireClient();
  const room = client.getRoom(roomId);

  if (!room || room.getMyMembership() !== 'join') {
    throw new Error('Комната не найдена или пользователь не состоит в ней.');
  }

  if (historyRequests.has(roomId)) {
    return historyRequests.get(roomId);
  }

  const request = (async () => {
    const timeline = room.getLiveTimeline();

    return client.paginateEventTimeline(timeline, {
      backwards: true,
      limit: Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(limit) || 30, 100))
    });
  })();

  historyRequests.set(roomId, request);

  try {
    return await request;
  } finally {
    historyRequests.delete(roomId);
  }
}

ФАЙЛ: frontend/infrastructure/matrix/sso.js

/**
 * REBUNAR — MATRIX SSO
 * Официальная авторизация через Matrix SSO.
 */

import { createClient } from 'matrix-js-sdk';

const MATRIX_HOMESERVER = 'https://matrix.org';
const SSO_STATE_KEY = 'rebunar_matrix_sso_state';

function createSsoState() {
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(32);
  window.crypto.getRandomValues(bytes);

  return Array.from(bytes, byte =>
    byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')
  ).join('');
}

export function startMatrixSso() {
  const state = createSsoState();

  sessionStorage.setItem(SSO_STATE_KEY, state);

  const redirectUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
  redirectUrl.search = '';
  redirectUrl.searchParams.set('state', state);

  const client = createClient({
    baseUrl: MATRIX_HOMESERVER
  });

  try {
    const ssoUrl = client.getSsoLoginUrl(redirectUrl.toString());
    window.location.assign(ssoUrl);
  } catch (error) {
    sessionStorage.removeItem(SSO_STATE_KEY);
    throw error;
  }
}

export function consumeMatrixSsoCallback() {
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const loginToken = params.get('loginToken');

  if (!loginToken) return null;

  const returnedState = params.get('state');
  const savedState = sessionStorage.getItem(SSO_STATE_KEY);

  sessionStorage.removeItem(SSO_STATE_KEY);

  // Удаляем одноразовый токен из адресной строки сразу.
  window.history.replaceState(
    {},
    document.title,
    window.location.pathname + window.location.hash
  );

  if (
    !savedState ||
    !returnedState ||
    savedState !== returnedState
  ) {
    throw new Error('Проверка Matrix SSO state не пройдена.');
  }

  return loginToken;
}

export async function exchangeMatrixSsoToken(loginToken) {
  if (!loginToken) {
    throw new Error('Matrix не передал одноразовый токен входа.');
  }

  const client = createClient({
    baseUrl: MATRIX_HOMESERVER
  });

  const login = await client.loginRequest({
    type: 'm.login.token',
    token: loginToken,
    initial_device_display_name: 'Rebunar'
  });

  if (!login.user_id || !login.access_token || !login.device_id) {
    throw new Error('Matrix вернул неполные данные авторизации.');
  }

  return {
    userId: login.user_id,
    accessToken: login.access_token,
    deviceId: login.device_id
  };
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — NAVIGATION
 * Управление кнопками навигации.
 */

export function initNavigation(root, navigate, subscribeToRoute) {
  root.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('[data-route]');

    if (!button || !root.contains(button)) {
      return;
    }

    const path = button.dataset.route;

    if (path) {
      navigate(path);
    }
  });

  function updateActiveRoute(route) {
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-route]').forEach(button => {
      const isActive = button.dataset.route === route.path;

      button.classList.toggle('is-active', isActive);
      button.setAttribute('aria-current', isActive ? 'page' : 'false');
    });
  }

  const unsubscribe = subscribeToRoute(updateActiveRoute);

  return {
    destroy() {
      unsubscribe();
    }
  };
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — API CLIENT
 * Единая точка взаимодействия с сервером.
 */

const API_BASE = '/api';

async function request(path, options = {}) {
  const config = {
    method: options.method || 'GET',
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    headers: {
      ...options.headers
    }
  };

  if (options.body !== undefined) {
    if (options.body instanceof FormData) {
      config.body = options.body;
    } else {
      config.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
      config.body = JSON.stringify(options.body);
    }
  }

  let response;

  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, config);
  } catch {
    throw new Error('Не удалось подключиться к серверу');
  }

  let data;

  try {
    data = await response.json();
  } catch {
    throw new Error('Сервер вернул некорректный ответ');
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(data.error || `Ошибка сервера: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return data;
}

export const api = {
  get(path) {
    return request(path);
  },

  post(path, body) {
    return request(path, {
      method: 'POST',
      body
    });
  },

  delete(path) {
    return request(path, {
      method: 'DELETE'
    });
  }
};

    description: 'Светлый зелёный с холодным подтоном, ощущение чистоты и простора.'
  },
  darkGreen: {
    name: 'Тёмный зелёный',
    description: 'Глубокий зелёный фон, элегантный и современный стиль.'
  },
  cyberNeon: {
    name: 'Кибер-неон',
    description: 'Футуристичный интерфейс с неоновыми зелёными и бирюзовыми акцентами.'
  }
};

export const DEFAULT_THEME = 'emerald';

export function getThemes() {
  return THEMES;
}

export function getTheme() {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY);

  if (Object.hasOwn(THEMES, saved)) {
    return saved;
  }

  localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, DEFAULT_THEME);
  return DEFAULT_THEME;
}

export function applyTheme(theme) {
  const selected = Object.hasOwn(THEMES, theme)
    ? theme
    : DEFAULT_THEME;

  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = selected;
  localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, selected);

  return selected;
}

export function initializeTheme() {
  applyTheme(getTheme());
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — APPLICATION ENTRY POINT
 */

import {
  registerRoute,
  navigate,
  initRouter,
  subscribeToRoute
} from './router.js';

import { createShell } from '../layout/shell.js';
import { initNavigation } from '../layout/navigation.js';
import {
  initializeAuth,
  getUser,
  clearUser
} from '../features/auth/session.js';

import { renderAuthScreen } from '../features/auth/view.js';
import { logout } from '../features/auth/api.js';
import { renderProfileScreen } from '../features/profile/view.js';
import { renderHomeScreen } from '../features/home/view.js';
import { renderStatisticsScreen } from '../features/statistics/view.js';
import { renderSettingsScreen } from '../features/settings/view.js';
import { startPresence, stopPresence } from '../features/statistics/presence.js';
import { initializeTheme } from '../shared/theme.js';

const root = document.getElementById('app');

if (!root) {
  throw new Error('Rebunar: элемент #app не найден');
}

const screens = {
  home: 'Главная',
  games: 'Игры',
  communities: 'Сообщества',
  messages: 'Сообщения',
  profile: 'Профиль',
  search: 'Поиск',
  notifications: 'Уведомления',
  composer: 'Создание публикации',
  settings: 'Настройки',
  statistics: 'Статистика'
};

for (const [path, title] of Object.entries(screens)) {
  registerRoute(path, () => {
    const outlet = document.getElementById('screen-outlet');

    if (!outlet) return;

    if (path === 'home') {
      renderHomeScreen(outlet);
      return;
    }

    if (path === 'profile') {
      renderProfileScreen(outlet, getUser(), handleLogout);
      return;
    }

    if (path === 'settings') {
      renderSettingsScreen(outlet);
      return;
    }

    if (path === 'statistics') {
      renderStatisticsScreen(outlet);
      return;
    }

    outlet.innerHTML = `
      <section class="screen">
        <h1>${title}</h1>
        <p>Раздел Rebunar подготовлен к разработке.</p>
      </section>
    `;
  });
}

let appStarted = false;
let navigationInitialized = false;
let routerInitialized = false;

async function handleLogout(event) {
  const button = event?.currentTarget;
  stopPresence();

  if (button) {
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Выходим...';
  }

  try {
    await logout();
    clearUser();

    appStarted = false;

    renderAuthScreen(root, mountApp);

    console.log('Rebunar: выход из аккаунта выполнен');
  } catch (error) {
    startPresence();
    console.error('Rebunar: ошибка выхода:', error);

    if (button) {
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = 'Выйти из аккаунта';
    }

    const message = document.createElement('p');
    message.className = 'profile-logout-error';
    message.textContent = 'Не удалось выйти: ' + error.message;

    const card = root.querySelector('.profile-card');
    if (card) card.appendChild(message);
  }
}

function mountApp() {
  if (appStarted) return;

  appStarted = true;
  startPresence();

  createShell(root);

  if (!navigationInitialized) {
    initNavigation(root, navigate, subscribeToRoute);
    navigationInitialized = true;
  }

  const user = getUser();

  console.log(
    'Rebunar: пользователь авторизован:',
    user ? user.username : 'неизвестен'
  );

  if (!routerInitialized) {
    initRouter('home');
    routerInitialized = true;
  } else {
    navigate('home');
  }

  console.log('Rebunar: приложение запущено');
}

async function startApp() {
  root.innerHTML = `
    <section class="screen">
      <h1>Rebunar</h1>
      <p>Проверка подключения и авторизации...</p>
    </section>
  `;

  await initializeAuth();

  if (getUser()) {
    mountApp();
    return;
  }

  renderAuthScreen(root, () => {
    mountApp();
  });

  console.log('Rebunar: ожидается вход пользователя');
}

initializeTheme();
startApp();

/**
 * REBUNAR — ROUTER
 * Единая система навигации приложения.
 */

const routes = new Map();
const listeners = new Set();

let currentRoute = null;

export function registerRoute(path, handler) {
  if (routes.has(path)) {
    throw new Error(`Маршрут уже зарегистрирован: ${path}`);
  }

  routes.set(path, handler);
}

export function navigate(path, params = {}) {
  const handler = routes.get(path);

  if (!handler) {
    console.error(`Маршрут не найден: ${path}`);
    return;
  }

  currentRoute = { path, params };

  window.history.pushState(currentRoute, '', `#${path}`);

  handler(params);

  listeners.forEach(listener => listener(currentRoute));
}

export function getCurrentRoute() {
  return currentRoute;
}

export function subscribeToRoute(listener) {
  listeners.add(listener);

  return () => listeners.delete(listener);
}

export function initRouter(defaultPath = 'home') {
  window.addEventListener('popstate', event => {
    const state = event.state;

    if (!state || !routes.has(state.path)) {
      navigate(defaultPath);
      return;
    }

    currentRoute = state;
    routes.get(state.path)(state.params || {});

    listeners.forEach(listener => listener(currentRoute));
  });

  const initialPath = window.location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/, '');

  if (initialPath && routes.has(initialPath)) {
    currentRoute = { path: initialPath, params: {} };
    routes.get(initialPath)({});
  } else {
    navigate(defaultPath);
  }
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — AUTH SESSION
 * Центральное состояние пользовательской сессии.
 */

import { getCurrentUser } from './api.js';

let currentUser = null;
let initialized = false;
const listeners = new Set();

export function getUser() {
  return currentUser;
}

export function isAuthenticated() {
  return Boolean(currentUser);
}

export function isAuthInitialized() {
  return initialized;
}

export function subscribeToAuth(listener) {
  listeners.add(listener);

  return () => listeners.delete(listener);
}

function notify() {
  listeners.forEach(listener => listener(currentUser));
}

export async function initializeAuth() {
  try {
    const result = await getCurrentUser();

    currentUser = result.logged_in ? result : null;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Rebunar: ошибка проверки авторизации:', error);
    currentUser = null;
  } finally {
    initialized = true;
    notify();
  }

  return currentUser;
}

export function setUser(user) {
  currentUser = user;
  initialized = true;
  notify();
}

export function clearUser() {
  currentUser = null;
  initialized = true;
  notify();
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — AUTH VIEW
 * Экран входа и регистрации.
 */

import { login, register } from './api.js';
import { setUser } from './session.js';

export function renderAuthScreen(container, onSuccess = () => {}) {
  let mode = 'login';

  function render(message = '') {
    const isRegister = mode === 'register';

    container.innerHTML = `
      <section class="auth-screen">
        <div class="auth-card">
          <div class="auth-brand">REBUNAR</div>
          <h1>${isRegister ? 'Создание аккаунта' : 'С возвращением'}</h1>
          <p class="auth-description">
            ${isRegister
              ? 'Создай аккаунт и присоединяйся к сообществу.'
              : 'Войди в свой аккаунт Rebunar.'}
          </p>

          <form class="auth-form">
            <label for="auth-username">Логин</label>
            <input
              id="auth-username"
              name="username"
              type="text"
              minlength="3"
              maxlength="50"
              autocomplete="username"
              placeholder="Твой логин"
              required
            >

            <label for="auth-password">Пароль</label>
            <input
              id="auth-password"
              name="password"
              type="password"
              minlength="4"
              autocomplete="${isRegister ? 'new-password' : 'current-password'}"
              placeholder="Твой пароль"
              required
            >

            <p class="auth-message" aria-live="polite"></p>

            <button class="auth-submit" type="submit">
              ${isRegister ? 'Зарегистрироваться' : 'Войти'}
            </button>
          </form>

          <button class="auth-switch" type="button">
            ${isRegister
              ? 'Уже есть аккаунт? Войти'
              : 'Нет аккаунта? Зарегистрироваться'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    `;

    const form = container.querySelector('.auth-form');
    const messageElement = container.querySelector('.auth-message');
    const switchButton = container.querySelector('.auth-switch');

    messageElement.textContent = message;

    switchButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
      mode = mode === 'login' ? 'register' : 'login';
      render();
    });

    form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
      event.preventDefault();

      const username = form.elements.username.value.trim();
      const password = form.elements.password.value;
      const submitButton = form.querySelector('.auth-submit');

      submitButton.disabled = true;
      submitButton.textContent = 'Подождите...';
      messageElement.textContent = '';

      try {
        let user;

        if (mode === 'register') {
          await register(username, password);
          messageElement.textContent = 'Аккаунт создан. Выполняем вход...';
          user = await login(username, password);
        } else {
          user = await login(username, password);
        }

        setUser(user);
        onSuccess(user);
      } catch (error) {
        messageElement.textContent = error.message;
        submitButton.disabled = false;
        submitButton.textContent = isRegister
          ? 'Зарегистрироваться'
          : 'Войти';
      }
    });
  }

  render();
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — PROFILE API
 */

import { api } from '../../shared/api/client.js';

export async function uploadAvatar(blob) {
  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append('avatar', blob, 'avatar.jpg');

  return api.post('/profile/avatar', formData);
}

export async function updateProfile(username, displayName, bio) {
  return api.post('/profile', {
    username,
    display_name: displayName,
    bio
  });
}

export async function changePassword(currentPassword, newPassword) {
  return api.post('/security/password', {
    current_password: currentPassword,
    new_password: newPassword
  });
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — PROFILE VIEW
 */

import { uploadAvatar, updateProfile } from './api.js';
import { setUser } from '../auth/session.js';

export function renderProfileScreen(container, user, onLogout) {
  const avatar = user.avatar
    ? `<img class="profile-avatar-image" src="${escapeHTML(user.avatar)}" alt="Аватар">`
    : `<div class="profile-avatar-placeholder">R</div>`;

  const displayName = user.display_name || user.username || 'Пользователь';
  const username = user.username || '—';
  const hasUserId = user.id !== undefined && user.id !== null;
  const userId = hasUserId ? String(user.id) : '—';
  const bio = user.bio || 'Пока нет описания профиля.';

  container.innerHTML = `
    <section class="screen profile-screen">
      <div class="profile-heading">
        <button class="screen-back" type="button" data-route="settings"
          aria-label="Назад к настройкам" title="Назад к настройкам">
          <span aria-hidden="true">⤺</span>
        </button>
        <h1>Профиль</h1>
        <span class="profile-status">Публичный профиль</span>
      </div>

      <div class="profile-card">
        <button class="profile-avatar profile-avatar-button"
          type="button" aria-label="Аватар профиля">
          ${avatar}
        </button>

        <input class="profile-avatar-input" type="file"
          accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" hidden>

        <div class="profile-account-id">
          <span>ID: ${escapeHTML(userId)}</span>
          <button class="profile-copy-id" type="button"
            aria-label="Скопировать ID" title="Скопировать ID"
            ${hasUserId ? '' : 'disabled'}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
              <rect x="8" y="8" width="12" height="12" rx="2"></rect>
              <path d="M16 8V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1H5a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h3"></path>
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div class="profile-identity">
          <h2>${escapeHTML(displayName)}</h2>
          <p class="profile-username">@${escapeHTML(username)}</p>
        </div>

        <div class="profile-details">
          <div class="profile-bio">
            <span>О себе</span>
            <p>${escapeHTML(bio)}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button class="profile-edit" type="button">
          Редактировать профиль
        </button>

        <button class="profile-logout" type="button">
          Выйти из аккаунта
        </button>
      </div>
    </section>
  `;

  container.querySelector('.profile-edit')
    .addEventListener('click', () => {
      openProfileEditor(container, user, onLogout);
    });

  container.querySelector('.profile-logout')
    .addEventListener('click', onLogout);

  container.querySelector('.profile-copy-id')
    .addEventListener('click', async (event) => {
      const button = event.currentTarget;

      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(userId);
        button.textContent = '✓';
        button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'ID скопирован');
        button.title = 'ID скопирован';
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Rebunar: не удалось скопировать ID:', error);
        button.title = 'Не удалось скопировать ID';
      }
    });

  const avatarButton = container.querySelector('.profile-avatar-button');
  const fileInput = container.querySelector('.profile-avatar-input');

  avatarButton.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click());

  fileInput.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const file = fileInput.files?.[0];
    if (file) openAvatarEditor(container, file, user, onLogout);
    fileInput.value = '';
  });
}


function openProfileEditor(container, user, onLogout) {
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'profile-editor-overlay';

  const currentDisplayName = user.display_name || '';
  const currentUsername = user.username || '';
  const currentBio = user.bio || '';

  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div class="profile-editor" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="profile-editor-title">

      <div class="profile-editor-heading">
        <h2 id="profile-editor-title">Редактирование профиля</h2>
        <button class="profile-editor-close" type="button"
          aria-label="Закрыть">×</button>
      </div>

      <div class="profile-editor-fields">

        <label class="profile-editor-field">
          <span>Имя</span>
          <input
            class="profile-editor-display-name"
            type="text"
            maxlength="100"
            autocomplete="name"
            value="${escapeHTML(currentDisplayName)}"
            placeholder="Ваше имя">
        </label>

        <label class="profile-editor-field">
          <span>Имя пользователя</span>
          <div class="profile-editor-username-wrap">
            <span>@</span>
            <input
              class="profile-editor-username"
              type="text"
              maxlength="50"
              autocomplete="username"
              value="${escapeHTML(currentUsername)}"
              placeholder="username">
          </div>
          <small>Используется для входа в аккаунт.</small>
        </label>

        <label class="profile-editor-field">
          <span>О себе</span>
          <textarea
            class="profile-editor-bio"
            maxlength="500"
            rows="5"
            placeholder="Расскажите немного о себе">${escapeHTML(currentBio)}</textarea>
        </label>

      </div>

      <p class="profile-editor-error" aria-live="polite"></p>

      <div class="profile-editor-actions">
        <button class="profile-editor-cancel" type="button">
          Отмена
        </button>
        <button class="profile-editor-save" type="button">
          Сохранить
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  container.appendChild(overlay);

  const displayNameInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-display-name');
  const usernameInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-username');
  const bioInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-bio');
  const errorText =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-error');
  const saveButton =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-save');

  let saving = false;

  function closeEditor() {
    if (saving) return;
    overlay.remove();
  }

  overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-close')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-cancel')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === overlay) closeEditor();
  });

  saveButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (saving) return;

    const displayName = displayNameInput.value.trim();
    const username = usernameInput.value.trim().replace(/^@+/, '');
    const bio = bioInput.value.trim();

    if (username.length < 3) {
      errorText.textContent =
        'Имя пользователя должно содержать минимум 3 символа.';
      usernameInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    saving = true;
    saveButton.disabled = true;
    saveButton.textContent = 'Сохраняем...';
    errorText.textContent = '';

    try {
      const result = await updateProfile(
        username,
        displayName,
        bio
      );

      const updatedUser = {
        ...user,
        username: result.username,
        display_name: result.display_name,
        bio: result.bio
      };

      setUser(updatedUser);
      overlay.remove();

      renderProfileScreen(
        container,
        updatedUser,
        onLogout
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        'Rebunar: ошибка сохранения профиля:',
        error
      );

      errorText.textContent =
        error.message || 'Не удалось сохранить профиль';

      saving = false;
      saveButton.disabled = false;
      saveButton.textContent = 'Сохранить';
    }
  });

  displayNameInput.focus();
}

function openAvatarEditor(container, file, user, onLogout) {
  if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
    alert('Выберите фотографию в формате JPG, PNG или WebP.');
    return;
  }

  if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) {
    alert('Размер исходной фотографии не должен превышать 15 МБ.');
    return;
  }

  const imageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
  const image = new Image();

  image.onload = () => {
    createCropEditor(container, image, imageUrl, user, onLogout);
  };

  image.onerror = () => {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
    alert('Не удалось открыть эту фотографию.');
  };

  image.src = imageUrl;
}

function createCropEditor(container, image, imageUrl, user, onLogout) {
  const stageSize = 260;
  const baseScale = Math.max(
    stageSize / image.naturalWidth,
    stageSize / image.naturalHeight
  );

  let zoom = 1;
  let offsetX = 0;
  let offsetY = 0;
  let pointerX = 0;
  let pointerY = 0;
  let dragging = false;
  let saving = false;

  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'avatar-editor-overlay';

  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div class="avatar-editor" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="avatar-editor-title">
      <div class="avatar-editor-heading">
        <h2 id="avatar-editor-title">Настройка аватара</h2>
        <button class="avatar-editor-close" type="button"
          aria-label="Закрыть">×</button>
      </div>

      <div class="avatar-editor-stage">
        <img class="avatar-editor-image" alt="Предпросмотр аватара">
      </div>

      <p class="avatar-editor-hint">
        Перемещайте фото пальцем, чтобы выбрать нужную область
      </p>

      <label class="avatar-editor-zoom">
        <span>Масштаб</span>
        <input class="avatar-editor-range" type="range"
          min="1" max="3" step="0.01" value="1">
      </label>

      <p class="avatar-editor-error" aria-live="polite"></p>

      <div class="avatar-editor-actions">
        <button class="avatar-editor-cancel" type="button">Отмена</button>
        <button class="avatar-editor-save" type="button">Сохранить</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  container.appendChild(overlay);

  const stage = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-stage');
  const preview = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-image');
  const range = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-range');
  const saveButton = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-save');
  const errorText = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-error');

  preview.src = image.src;

  function clampPosition() {
    const width = image.naturalWidth * baseScale * zoom;
    const height = image.naturalHeight * baseScale * zoom;

    const maxX = Math.max(0, (width - stageSize) / 2);
    const maxY = Math.max(0, (height - stageSize) / 2);

    offsetX = Math.max(-maxX, Math.min(maxX, offsetX));
    offsetY = Math.max(-maxY, Math.min(maxY, offsetY));
  }

  function updatePreview() {
    clampPosition();

    const width = image.naturalWidth * baseScale * zoom;
    const height = image.naturalHeight * baseScale * zoom;

    preview.style.width = `${width}px`;
    preview.style.height = `${height}px`;
    preview.style.transform =
      `translate(calc(-50% + ${offsetX}px), calc(-50% + ${offsetY}px))`;
  }

  function closeEditor() {
    if (saving) return;
    overlay.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
  }

  overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-close')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-cancel')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === overlay) closeEditor();
  });

  range.addEventListener('input', () => {
    zoom = Number(range.value);
    updatePreview();
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
    dragging = true;
    pointerX = event.clientX;
    pointerY = event.clientY;
    stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
    if (!dragging) return;

    offsetX += event.clientX - pointerX;
    offsetY += event.clientY - pointerY;

    pointerX = event.clientX;
    pointerY = event.clientY;

    updatePreview();
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
    dragging = false;
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
    dragging = false;
  });

  saveButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (saving) return;

    saving = true;
    saveButton.disabled = true;
    saveButton.textContent = 'Сохраняем...';
    errorText.textContent = '';

    try {
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = 512;
      canvas.height = 512;

      const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
      if (!context) throw new Error('Не удалось подготовить изображение');

      const factor = 512 / stageSize;
      const width = image.naturalWidth * baseScale * zoom * factor;
      const height = image.naturalHeight * baseScale * zoom * factor;
      const x = (stageSize / 2 + offsetX) * factor - width / 2;
      const y = (stageSize / 2 + offsetY) * factor - height / 2;

      context.drawImage(image, x, y, width, height);

      const blob = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        canvas.toBlob(
          result => result
            ? resolve(result)
            : reject(new Error('Не удалось обработать фотографию')),
          'image/jpeg',
          0.9
        );
      });

      const result = await uploadAvatar(blob);

      if (!result.avatar) {
        throw new Error('Сервер не вернул адрес аватара');
      }

      setUser({ ...user, avatar: result.avatar });
      overlay.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);

      renderProfileScreen(container, { ...user, avatar: result.avatar },
        onLogout);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Rebunar: ошибка сохранения аватара:', error);
      errorText.textContent = error.message || 'Не удалось сохранить аватар';
      saving = false;
      saveButton.disabled = false;
      saveButton.textContent = 'Сохранить';
    }
  });

  updatePreview();
}

function escapeHTML(value) {
  return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    '"': '&quot;',
    "'": '&#039;'
  })[character]);
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — SETTINGS
 * Центральный раздел настроек приложения.

import { changePassword } from '../profile/api.js';

  outlet.querySelector('[data-action="security"]')
    .addEventListener('click', () => {

  outlet.querySelector('[data-action="appearance"]')

function openSecurityEditor(outlet) {
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'security-editor-overlay';

  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div class="security-editor" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="security-editor-title">

      <div class="security-editor-heading">
        <h2 id="security-editor-title">Безопасность</h2>
        <button class="security-editor-close" type="button"
          aria-label="Закрыть">×</button>
      </div>

      <p class="security-editor-description">
        Измените пароль для входа в аккаунт Rebunar.
      </p>

      <div class="security-editor-fields">

        <label class="security-editor-field">
          <span>Текущий пароль</span>
          <input
            class="security-current-password"
            type="password"
            autocomplete="current-password"
            placeholder="Введите текущий пароль">
        </label>

        <label class="security-editor-field">
          <span>Новый пароль</span>
          <input
            class="security-new-password"
            type="password"
            autocomplete="new-password"
            minlength="4"
            placeholder="Минимум 4 символа">
        </label>

        <label class="security-editor-field">
          <span>Повтор нового пароля</span>
          <input
            class="security-confirm-password"
            type="password"
            autocomplete="new-password"
            minlength="4"
            placeholder="Повторите новый пароль">
        </label>

      </div>

      <p class="security-editor-error" aria-live="polite"></p>

      <div class="security-editor-actions">
        <button class="security-editor-cancel" type="button">
          Отмена
        </button>
        <button class="security-editor-save" type="button">
          Сохранить
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  outlet.appendChild(overlay);

  const currentInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.security-current-password');
  const newInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.security-new-password');
  const confirmInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.security-confirm-password');
  const errorText =
    overlay.querySelector('.security-editor-error');
  const saveButton =
    overlay.querySelector('.security-editor-save');

  let saving = false;

  function closeEditor() {
    if (saving) return;
    overlay.remove();
  }

  overlay.querySelector('.security-editor-close')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.querySelector('.security-editor-cancel')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === overlay) closeEditor();
  });

  saveButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (saving) return;

    const currentPassword = currentInput.value;
    const newPassword = newInput.value;
    const confirmPassword = confirmInput.value;

    errorText.textContent = '';

    if (!currentPassword) {
      errorText.textContent = 'Введите текущий пароль.';
      currentInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword.length < 4) {
      errorText.textContent =
        'Новый пароль должен содержать минимум 4 символа.';
      newInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
      errorText.textContent =
        'Новые пароли не совпадают.';
      confirmInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    if (currentPassword === newPassword) {
      errorText.textContent =
        'Новый пароль должен отличаться от текущего.';
      newInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    saving = true;
    saveButton.disabled = true;
    saveButton.textContent = 'Сохраняем...';

    try {
      await changePassword(currentPassword, newPassword);

      currentInput.value = '';
      newInput.value = '';
      confirmInput.value = '';

      overlay.remove();

      alert('Пароль успешно изменён.');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        'Rebunar: ошибка смены пароля:',
        error
      );

      errorText.textContent =
        error.message || 'Не удалось изменить пароль';

      saving = false;
      saveButton.disabled = false;
      saveButton.textContent = 'Сохранить';
    }
  });

  currentInput.focus();
}


function openAppearanceEditor(outlet) {
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'appearance-editor-overlay';

  const currentTheme = getTheme();
  const themes = getThemes();

  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div class="appearance-editor" role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="appearance-editor-title">

      <div class="appearance-editor-heading">
        <div>
          <span class="appearance-editor-eyebrow">
            REBUNAR / APPEARANCE
          </span>
          <h2 id="appearance-editor-title">Оформление</h2>
        </div>

        <button class="appearance-editor-close"
          type="button" aria-label="Закрыть">×</button>
      </div>

      <div class="appearance-editor-section">
        <div class="appearance-editor-section-heading">
          <strong>Выбери свою тему</strong>
          <span>Шесть вариантов оформления Rebunar</span>
        </div>

        <div class="appearance-theme-options">
          ${Object.entries(themes).map(([key, theme]) => `
            <button
              class="appearance-theme-option ${currentTheme === key ? 'is-active' : ''}"
              type="button"
              data-theme="${key}">

              <span class="appearance-theme-preview appearance-theme-preview-${key}">
                <span></span>
                <span></span>
                <span></span>
              </span>

              <span class="appearance-theme-info">
                <strong>${theme.name}</strong>
                <small>${theme.description}</small>
              </span>

              <span class="appearance-theme-check">✓</span>
            </button>
          `).join('')}
        </div>
      </div>

      <p class="appearance-editor-note">
        Яркий изумруд установлен по умолчанию. Другие темы можно выбрать в любое время.
      </p>
    </div>
  `;

  outlet.appendChild(overlay);

  function closeEditor() {
    overlay.remove();
  }

  overlay.querySelector('.appearance-editor-close')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === overlay) {
      closeEditor();
    }
  });

  overlay.querySelectorAll('[data-theme]').forEach((button) => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const theme = button.dataset.theme;
      applyTheme(theme);

      overlay.querySelectorAll('[data-theme]').forEach((item) => {
        item.classList.toggle(
          'is-active',
          item.dataset.theme === theme
        );
      });
    });
  });
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — STATISTICS API
 * Получение публичной статистики платформы.
 */

import { api } from '../../shared/api/client.js';

export function getStatisticsSummary() {
  return api.get('/statistics/summary');
}

export function getStatisticsHistory(period = 'week') {
  const allowedPeriods = ['week', 'month', 'year'];

  if (!allowedPeriods.includes(period)) {
    throw new Error('Недопустимый период статистики');
  }

  return api.get(`/statistics/history?period=${period}`);
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — USER PRESENCE
 * Обновление активности авторизованного пользователя.
 */

import { api } from '../../shared/api/client.js';

let heartbeatTimer = null;

async function sendHeartbeat() {
  try {
    await api.post('/presence/heartbeat', {});
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Rebunar: не удалось обновить активность:', error.message);
  }
}

export function startPresence() {
  if (heartbeatTimer !== null) return;

  sendHeartbeat();
  heartbeatTimer = setInterval(sendHeartbeat, 60_000);
}

export function stopPresence() {
  if (heartbeatTimer !== null) {
    clearInterval(heartbeatTimer);
    heartbeatTimer = null;
  }
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — STATISTICS VIEW
 * Экран публичной статистики платформы.
 */

import {
  getStatisticsSummary,
  getStatisticsHistory
} from './api.js';

const PERIODS = {
  week: 'Неделя',
  month: 'Месяц',
  year: 'Год'
};

function formatDate(value, period) {
  const date = new Date(value + 'T00:00:00');

  if (period === 'year') {
    return date.toLocaleDateString('ru-RU', {
      month: 'short'
    });
  }

  return date.toLocaleDateString('ru-RU', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short'
  });
}

function createChart(registrations, period) {
  const width = 720;
  const height = 260;
  const padding = { top: 24, right: 24, bottom: 42, left: 42 };

  const innerWidth = width - padding.left - padding.right;
  const innerHeight = height - padding.top - padding.bottom;

  const values = registrations.map(item => item.count);
  const maxValue = Math.max(1, ...values);
  const points = registrations.map((item, index) => {
    const x = padding.left +
      (registrations.length > 1
        ? index / (registrations.length - 1) * innerWidth
        : innerWidth / 2);

    const y = padding.top +
      innerHeight - item.count / maxValue * innerHeight;

    return {
      x,
      y,
      date: item.date,
      count: item.count
    };
  });

  const line = points
    .map((point, index) =>
      `${index === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'} ${point.x} ${point.y}`
    )
    .join(' ');

  const area = points.length
    ? `${line} L ${points[points.length - 1].x} ${padding.top + innerHeight} L ${points[0].x} ${padding.top + innerHeight} Z`
    : '';

  const grid = [0, 1, 2, 3].map(step => {
    const y = padding.top + innerHeight * step / 3;
    const value = Math.round(maxValue * (3 - step) / 3);

    return `
      <line x1="${padding.left}" y1="${y}"
            x2="${width - padding.right}" y2="${y}"
            class="statistics-grid-line"/>
      <text x="${padding.left - 10}" y="${y + 4}"
            text-anchor="end" class="statistics-axis-label">${value}</text>
    `;
  }).join('');

  const markers = points.map(point => `
    <circle cx="${point.x}" cy="${point.y}" r="4"
            class="statistics-point">
      <title>${point.date}: ${point.count}</title>
    </circle>
  `).join('');

  const labels = points
    .filter((point, index) =>
      index === 0 ||
      index === points.length - 1 ||
      (period === 'week' && index === Math.floor(points.length / 2)) ||
      (period !== 'week' && index % Math.ceil(points.length / 5) === 0)
    )
    .map(point => `
      <text x="${point.x}" y="${height - 12}"
            text-anchor="middle" class="statistics-axis-label">
        ${formatDate(point.date, period)}
      </text>
    `).join('');

  return `
    <svg class="statistics-chart" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}"
         role="img" aria-label="График регистраций">
      ${grid}
      ${area ? `<path d="${area}" class="statistics-area"/>` : ''}
      ${points.length > 1
        ? `<path d="${line}" class="statistics-line"/>`
        : ''}
      ${markers}
      ${labels}
    </svg>
  `;
}

export async function renderStatisticsScreen(outlet) {
  outlet.innerHTML = `
    <section class="screen statistics-screen">
      <div class="statistics-heading">
        <div>
          <button class="screen-back" type="button" data-route="settings" aria-label="Назад к настройкам" title="Назад к настройкам">
            <span aria-hidden="true">⤺</span>
          </button>
          <span class="statistics-eyebrow">REBUNAR / ANALYTICS</span>
          <h1>Статистика</h1>
          <p>Развитие и активность платформы</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="statistics-summary-grid">
        <article class="statistics-card">
          <span>Всего аккаунтов</span>
          <strong id="statistics-total">—</strong>
        </article>

        <article class="statistics-card">
          <span>Сейчас онлайн</span>
          <strong id="statistics-online">—</strong>
        </article>
      </div>

      <section class="statistics-chart-card">
        <div class="statistics-chart-header">
          <div>
            <h2>Рост регистраций</h2>
            <p id="statistics-period-total">Загрузка данных...</p>
          </div>

          <div class="statistics-periods">
            ${Object.entries(PERIODS).map(([key, label]) => `
              <button type="button"
                      data-statistics-period="${key}"
                      class="${key === 'week' ? 'is-active' : ''}">
                ${label}
              </button>
            `).join('')}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div id="statistics-chart-container"
             class="statistics-chart-container">
          <p>Загружаем график...</p>
        </div>
      </section>

      <p class="statistics-footnote">
        Данные обновляются с сервера Rebunar.
      </p>
    </section>
  `;

  const totalElement = outlet.querySelector('#statistics-total');
  const onlineElement = outlet.querySelector('#statistics-online');
  const periodTotal = outlet.querySelector('#statistics-period-total');
  const chartContainer = outlet.querySelector('#statistics-chart-container');
  const periodButtons = outlet.querySelectorAll('[data-statistics-period]');

  let selectedPeriod = 'week';
  let requestNumber = 0;

  async function loadPeriod(period) {
    selectedPeriod = period;
    const currentRequest = ++requestNumber;

    periodButtons.forEach(button => {
      button.classList.toggle(
        'is-active',
        button.dataset.statisticsPeriod === period
      );
    });

    chartContainer.innerHTML = '<p>Загружаем график...</p>';
    periodTotal.textContent = 'Загрузка данных...';

    try {
      const data = await getStatisticsHistory(period);

      if (currentRequest !== requestNumber) return;

      const registrations = data.registrations || [];
      const total = registrations.reduce(
        (sum, item) => sum + item.count,
        0
      );

      periodTotal.textContent = `${total} новых регистраций за период`;

      chartContainer.innerHTML = registrations.length
        ? createChart(registrations, period)
        : '<p class="statistics-empty">Пока нет регистраций за этот период.</p>';
    } catch (error) {
      if (currentRequest !== requestNumber) return;

      chartContainer.innerHTML =
        '<p class="statistics-error">Не удалось загрузить график.</p>';

      periodTotal.textContent = error.message;
    }
  }

  periodButtons.forEach(button => {
    button.addEventListener('click', () => {
      loadPeriod(button.dataset.statisticsPeriod);
    });
  });

  try {
    const summary = await getStatisticsSummary();
    totalElement.textContent = summary.total_users ?? 0;
    onlineElement.textContent = summary.online_users ?? 0;
  } catch (error) {
    totalElement.textContent = '—';
    onlineElement.textContent = '—';
    console.error('Rebunar: ошибка статистики:', error);
  }

  await loadPeriod(selectedPeriod);
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — NAVIGATION
 * Управление кнопками навигации.
 */

export function initNavigation(root, navigate, subscribeToRoute) {
  root.addEventListener('click', event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('[data-route]');

    if (!button || !root.contains(button)) {
      return;
    }

    const path = button.dataset.route;

    if (path) {
      navigate(path);
    }
  });

  function updateActiveRoute(route) {
    root.querySelectorAll('[data-route]').forEach(button => {
      const isActive = button.dataset.route === route.path;

      button.classList.toggle('is-active', isActive);
      button.setAttribute('aria-current', isActive ? 'page' : 'false');
    });
  }

  const unsubscribe = subscribeToRoute(updateActiveRoute);

  return {
    destroy() {
      unsubscribe();
    }
  };
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — API CLIENT
 * Единая точка взаимодействия с сервером.
 */

const API_BASE = '/api';

async function request(path, options = {}) {
  const config = {
    method: options.method || 'GET',
    credentials: 'same-origin',
    headers: {
      ...options.headers
    }
  };

  if (options.body !== undefined) {
    if (options.body instanceof FormData) {
      config.body = options.body;
    } else {
      config.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
      config.body = JSON.stringify(options.body);
    }
  }

  let response;

  try {
    response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`, config);
  } catch {
    throw new Error('Не удалось подключиться к серверу');
  }

  let data;

  try {
    data = await response.json();
  } catch {
    throw new Error('Сервер вернул некорректный ответ');
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(data.error || `Ошибка сервера: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return data;
}

export const api = {
  get(path) {
    return request(path);
  },

  post(path, body) {
    return request(path, {
      method: 'POST',
      body
    });
  },

  delete(path) {
    return request(path, {
      method: 'DELETE'
    });
  }
};

const THEME_STORAGE_KEY = 'rebunar-theme';

export const THEMES = {
  emerald: {
    name: 'Яркий изумруд',
    description: 'Насыщенный зелёный, сбалансированный и приятный для глаз.'
  },
  neon: {
    name: 'Неон',
    description: 'Максимум яркости и насыщенные светящиеся оттенки.'
  },
  forest: {
    name: 'Лесной',
    description: 'Природные оттенки зелёного, спокойный и стильный вид.'
  },
  mint: {
    name: 'Мятный',
    description: 'Светлый зелёный с холодным подтоном, ощущение чистоты и простора.'
  },
  darkGreen: {
    name: 'Тёмный зелёный',
    description: 'Глубокий зелёный фон, элегантный и современный стиль.'
  },
  cyberNeon: {
    name: 'Кибер-неон',
    description: 'Футуристичный интерфейс с неоновыми зелёными и бирюзовыми акцентами.'
  }
};

export const DEFAULT_THEME = 'emerald';

export function getThemes() {
  return THEMES;
}

export function getTheme() {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY);

  if (Object.hasOwn(THEMES, saved)) {
    return saved;
  }

  localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, DEFAULT_THEME);
  return DEFAULT_THEME;
}

export function applyTheme(theme) {
  const selected = Object.hasOwn(THEMES, theme)
    ? theme
    : DEFAULT_THEME;

  document.documentElement.dataset.theme = selected;
  localStorage.setItem(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, selected);

  return selected;
}

export function initializeTheme() {
  applyTheme(getTheme());
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — APPLICATION ENTRY POINT
 */

import {
  registerRoute,
  navigate,
  initRouter,
  subscribeToRoute
} from './router.js';

import { createShell } from '../layout/shell.js';
import { initNavigation } from '../layout/navigation.js';
import {
  initializeAuth,
  getUser,
  clearUser
} from '../features/auth/session.js';

import { renderAuthScreen } from '../features/auth/view.js';
import { logout } from '../features/auth/api.js';
import { renderProfileScreen } from '../features/profile/view.js';
import { renderHomeScreen } from '../features/home/view.js';
import { renderStatisticsScreen } from '../features/statistics/view.js';
import { renderSettingsScreen } from '../features/settings/view.js';
import { startPresence, stopPresence } from '../features/statistics/presence.js';
import { initializeTheme } from '../shared/theme.js';

const root = document.getElementById('app');

if (!root) {
  throw new Error('Rebunar: элемент #app не найден');
}

const screens = {
  home: 'Главная',
  games: 'Игры',
  communities: 'Сообщества',
  messages: 'Сообщения',
  profile: 'Профиль',
  search: 'Поиск',
  notifications: 'Уведомления',
  composer: 'Создание публикации',
  settings: 'Настройки',
  statistics: 'Статистика'
};

for (const [path, title] of Object.entries(screens)) {
  registerRoute(path, () => {
    const outlet = document.getElementById('screen-outlet');

    if (!outlet) return;

    if (path === 'home') {
      renderHomeScreen(outlet);
      return;
    }

    if (path === 'profile') {
      renderProfileScreen(outlet, getUser(), handleLogout);
      return;
    }

    if (path === 'settings') {
      renderSettingsScreen(outlet);
      return;
    }

    if (path === 'statistics') {
      renderStatisticsScreen(outlet);
      return;
    }

    outlet.innerHTML = `
      <section class="screen">
        <h1>${title}</h1>
        <p>Раздел Rebunar подготовлен к разработке.</p>
      </section>
    `;
  });
}

let appStarted = false;
let navigationInitialized = false;
let routerInitialized = false;

async function handleLogout(event) {
  const button = event?.currentTarget;
  stopPresence();

  if (button) {
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Выходим...';
  }

  try {
    await logout();
    clearUser();

    appStarted = false;

    renderAuthScreen(root, mountApp);

    console.log('Rebunar: выход из аккаунта выполнен');
  } catch (error) {
    startPresence();
    console.error('Rebunar: ошибка выхода:', error);

    if (button) {
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = 'Выйти из аккаунта';
    }

    const message = document.createElement('p');
    message.className = 'profile-logout-error';
    message.textContent = 'Не удалось выйти: ' + error.message;

    const card = root.querySelector('.profile-card');
    if (card) card.appendChild(message);
  }
}

function mountApp() {
  if (appStarted) return;

  appStarted = true;
  startPresence();

  createShell(root);

  if (!navigationInitialized) {
    initNavigation(root, navigate, subscribeToRoute);
    navigationInitialized = true;
  }

  const user = getUser();

  console.log(
    'Rebunar: пользователь авторизован:',
    user ? user.username : 'неизвестен'
  );

  if (!routerInitialized) {
    initRouter('home');
    routerInitialized = true;
  } else {
    navigate('home');
  }

  console.log('Rebunar: приложение запущено');
}

async function startApp() {
  root.innerHTML = `
    <section class="screen">
      <h1>Rebunar</h1>
      <p>Проверка подключения и авторизации...</p>
    </section>
  `;

  await initializeAuth();

  if (getUser()) {
    mountApp();
    return;
  }

  renderAuthScreen(root, () => {
    mountApp();
  });

  console.log('Rebunar: ожидается вход пользователя');
}

initializeTheme();
startApp();

/**
 * REBUNAR — ROUTER
 * Единая система навигации приложения.
 */

const routes = new Map();
const listeners = new Set();

let currentRoute = null;

export function registerRoute(path, handler) {
  if (routes.has(path)) {
    throw new Error(`Маршрут уже зарегистрирован: ${path}`);
  }

  routes.set(path, handler);
}

export function navigate(path, params = {}) {
  const handler = routes.get(path);

  if (!handler) {
    console.error(`Маршрут не найден: ${path}`);
    return;
  }

  currentRoute = { path, params };

  window.history.pushState(currentRoute, '', `#${path}`);

  handler(params);

  listeners.forEach(listener => listener(currentRoute));
}

export function getCurrentRoute() {
  return currentRoute;
}

export function subscribeToRoute(listener) {
  listeners.add(listener);

  return () => listeners.delete(listener);
}

export function initRouter(defaultPath = 'home') {
  window.addEventListener('popstate', event => {
    const state = event.state;

    if (!state || !routes.has(state.path)) {
      navigate(defaultPath);
      return;
    }

    currentRoute = state;
    routes.get(state.path)(state.params || {});

    listeners.forEach(listener => listener(currentRoute));
  });

  const initialPath = window.location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/, '');

  if (initialPath && routes.has(initialPath)) {
    currentRoute = { path: initialPath, params: {} };
    routes.get(initialPath)({});
  } else {
    navigate(defaultPath);
  }
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — AUTH SESSION
 * Центральное состояние пользовательской сессии.
 */

import { getCurrentUser } from './api.js';

let currentUser = null;
let initialized = false;
const listeners = new Set();

export function getUser() {
  return currentUser;
}

export function isAuthenticated() {
  return Boolean(currentUser);
}

export function isAuthInitialized() {
  return initialized;
}

export function subscribeToAuth(listener) {
  listeners.add(listener);

  return () => listeners.delete(listener);
}

function notify() {
  listeners.forEach(listener => listener(currentUser));
}

export async function initializeAuth() {
  try {
    const result = await getCurrentUser();

    currentUser = result.logged_in ? result : null;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Rebunar: ошибка проверки авторизации:', error);
    currentUser = null;
  } finally {
    initialized = true;
    notify();
  }

  return currentUser;
}

export function setUser(user) {
  currentUser = user;
  initialized = true;
  notify();
}

export function clearUser() {
  currentUser = null;
  initialized = true;
  notify();
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — AUTH VIEW
 * Экран входа и регистрации.
 */

import { login, register } from './api.js';
import { setUser } from './session.js';

export function renderAuthScreen(container, onSuccess = () => {}) {
  let mode = 'login';

  function render(message = '') {
    const isRegister = mode === 'register';

    container.innerHTML = `
      <section class="auth-screen">
        <div class="auth-card">
          <div class="auth-brand">REBUNAR</div>
          <h1>${isRegister ? 'Создание аккаунта' : 'С возвращением'}</h1>
          <p class="auth-description">
            ${isRegister
              ? 'Создай аккаунт и присоединяйся к сообществу.'
              : 'Войди в свой аккаунт Rebunar.'}
          </p>

          <form class="auth-form">
            <label for="auth-username">Логин</label>
            <input
              id="auth-username"
              name="username"
              type="text"
              minlength="3"
              maxlength="50"
              autocomplete="username"
              placeholder="Твой логин"
              required
            >

            <label for="auth-password">Пароль</label>
            <input
              id="auth-password"
              name="password"
              type="password"
              minlength="4"
              autocomplete="${isRegister ? 'new-password' : 'current-password'}"
              placeholder="Твой пароль"
              required
            >

            <p class="auth-message" aria-live="polite"></p>

            <button class="auth-submit" type="submit">
              ${isRegister ? 'Зарегистрироваться' : 'Войти'}
            </button>
          </form>

          <button class="auth-switch" type="button">
            ${isRegister
              ? 'Уже есть аккаунт? Войти'
              : 'Нет аккаунта? Зарегистрироваться'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    `;

    const form = container.querySelector('.auth-form');
    const messageElement = container.querySelector('.auth-message');
    const switchButton = container.querySelector('.auth-switch');

    messageElement.textContent = message;

    switchButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
      mode = mode === 'login' ? 'register' : 'login';
      render();
    });

    form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
      event.preventDefault();

      const username = form.elements.username.value.trim();
      const password = form.elements.password.value;
      const submitButton = form.querySelector('.auth-submit');

      submitButton.disabled = true;
      submitButton.textContent = 'Подождите...';
      messageElement.textContent = '';

      try {
        let user;

        if (mode === 'register') {
          await register(username, password);
          messageElement.textContent = 'Аккаунт создан. Выполняем вход...';
          user = await login(username, password);
        } else {
          user = await login(username, password);
        }

        setUser(user);
        onSuccess(user);
      } catch (error) {
        messageElement.textContent = error.message;
        submitButton.disabled = false;
        submitButton.textContent = isRegister
          ? 'Зарегистрироваться'
          : 'Войти';
      }
    });
  }

  render();
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — PROFILE API
 */

import { api } from '../../shared/api/client.js';

export async function uploadAvatar(blob) {
  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append('avatar', blob, 'avatar.jpg');

  return api.post('/profile/avatar', formData);
}

export async function updateProfile(username, displayName, bio) {
  return api.post('/profile', {
    username,
    display_name: displayName,
    bio
  });
}

export async function changePassword(currentPassword, newPassword) {
  return api.post('/security/password', {
    current_password: currentPassword,
    new_password: newPassword
  });
}

/**
 * REBUNAR — PROFILE VIEW
 */

import { uploadAvatar, updateProfile } from './api.js';
import { setUser } from '../auth/session.js';

export function renderProfileScreen(container, user, onLogout) {
  const avatar = user.avatar
    ? `<img class="profile-avatar-image" src="${escapeHTML(user.avatar)}" alt="Аватар">`
    : `<div class="profile-avatar-placeholder">R</div>`;

  const displayName = user.display_name || user.username || 'Пользователь';
  const username = user.username || '—';
  const hasUserId = user.id !== undefined && user.id !== null;
  const userId = hasUserId ? String(user.id) : '—';
  const bio = user.bio || 'Пока нет описания профиля.';

  container.innerHTML = `
    <section class="screen profile-screen">
      <div class="profile-heading">
        <button class="screen-back" type="button" data-route="settings"
          aria-label="Назад к настройкам" title="Назад к настройкам">
          <span aria-hidden="true">⤺</span>
        </button>
        <h1>Профиль</h1>
        <span class="profile-status">Публичный профиль</span>
      </div>

      <div class="profile-card">
        <button class="profile-avatar profile-avatar-button"
          type="button" aria-label="Аватар профиля">
          ${avatar}
        </button>

        <input class="profile-avatar-input" type="file"
          accept="image/jpeg,image/png,image/webp" hidden>

        <div class="profile-account-id">
          <span>ID: ${escapeHTML(userId)}</span>
          <button class="profile-copy-id" type="button"
            aria-label="Скопировать ID" title="Скопировать ID"
            ${hasUserId ? '' : 'disabled'}>
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
              <rect x="8" y="8" width="12" height="12" rx="2"></rect>
              <path d="M16 8V5a1 1 0 0 0-1-1H5a1 1 0 0 0-1 1v10a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h3"></path>
            </svg>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div class="profile-identity">
          <h2>${escapeHTML(displayName)}</h2>
          <p class="profile-username">@${escapeHTML(username)}</p>
        </div>

        <div class="profile-details">
          <div class="profile-bio">
            <span>О себе</span>
            <p>${escapeHTML(bio)}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button class="profile-edit" type="button">
          Редактировать профиль
        </button>

        <button class="profile-logout" type="button">
          Выйти из аккаунта
        </button>
      </div>
    </section>
  `;

  container.querySelector('.profile-edit')
    .addEventListener('click', () => {
      openProfileEditor(container, user, onLogout);
    });

  container.querySelector('.profile-logout')
    .addEventListener('click', onLogout);

  container.querySelector('.profile-copy-id')
    .addEventListener('click', async (event) => {
      const button = event.currentTarget;

      try {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(userId);
        button.textContent = '✓';
        button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'ID скопирован');
        button.title = 'ID скопирован';
      } catch (error) {
        console.warn('Rebunar: не удалось скопировать ID:', error);
        button.title = 'Не удалось скопировать ID';
      }
    });

  const avatarButton = container.querySelector('.profile-avatar-button');
  const fileInput = container.querySelector('.profile-avatar-input');

  avatarButton.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click());

  fileInput.addEventListener('change', () => {
    const file = fileInput.files?.[0];
    if (file) openAvatarEditor(container, file, user, onLogout);
    fileInput.value = '';
  });
}


function openProfileEditor(container, user, onLogout) {
  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'profile-editor-overlay';

  const currentDisplayName = user.display_name || '';
  const currentUsername = user.username || '';
  const currentBio = user.bio || '';

  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div class="profile-editor" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="profile-editor-title">

      <div class="profile-editor-heading">
        <h2 id="profile-editor-title">Редактирование профиля</h2>
        <button class="profile-editor-close" type="button"
          aria-label="Закрыть">×</button>
      </div>

      <div class="profile-editor-fields">

        <label class="profile-editor-field">
          <span>Имя</span>
          <input
            class="profile-editor-display-name"
            type="text"
            maxlength="100"
            autocomplete="name"
            value="${escapeHTML(currentDisplayName)}"
            placeholder="Ваше имя">
        </label>

        <label class="profile-editor-field">
          <span>Имя пользователя</span>
          <div class="profile-editor-username-wrap">
            <span>@</span>
            <input
              class="profile-editor-username"
              type="text"
              maxlength="50"
              autocomplete="username"
              value="${escapeHTML(currentUsername)}"
              placeholder="username">
          </div>
          <small>Используется для входа в аккаунт.</small>
        </label>

        <label class="profile-editor-field">
          <span>О себе</span>
          <textarea
            class="profile-editor-bio"
            maxlength="500"
            rows="5"
            placeholder="Расскажите немного о себе">${escapeHTML(currentBio)}</textarea>
        </label>

      </div>

      <p class="profile-editor-error" aria-live="polite"></p>

      <div class="profile-editor-actions">
        <button class="profile-editor-cancel" type="button">
          Отмена
        </button>
        <button class="profile-editor-save" type="button">
          Сохранить
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  container.appendChild(overlay);

  const displayNameInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-display-name');
  const usernameInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-username');
  const bioInput =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-bio');
  const errorText =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-error');
  const saveButton =
    overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-save');

  let saving = false;

  function closeEditor() {
    if (saving) return;
    overlay.remove();
  }

  overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-close')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.querySelector('.profile-editor-cancel')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === overlay) closeEditor();
  });

  saveButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (saving) return;

    const displayName = displayNameInput.value.trim();
    const username = usernameInput.value.trim().replace(/^@+/, '');
    const bio = bioInput.value.trim();

    if (username.length < 3) {
      errorText.textContent =
        'Имя пользователя должно содержать минимум 3 символа.';
      usernameInput.focus();
      return;
    }

    saving = true;
    saveButton.disabled = true;
    saveButton.textContent = 'Сохраняем...';
    errorText.textContent = '';

    try {
      const result = await updateProfile(
        username,
        displayName,
        bio
      );

      const updatedUser = {
        ...user,
        username: result.username,
        display_name: result.display_name,
        bio: result.bio
      };

      setUser(updatedUser);
      overlay.remove();

      renderProfileScreen(
        container,
        updatedUser,
        onLogout
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        'Rebunar: ошибка сохранения профиля:',
        error
      );

      errorText.textContent =
        error.message || 'Не удалось сохранить профиль';

      saving = false;
      saveButton.disabled = false;
      saveButton.textContent = 'Сохранить';
    }
  });

  displayNameInput.focus();
}

function openAvatarEditor(container, file, user, onLogout) {
  if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
    alert('Выберите фотографию в формате JPG, PNG или WebP.');
    return;
  }

  if (file.size > 15 * 1024 * 1024) {
    alert('Размер исходной фотографии не должен превышать 15 МБ.');
    return;
  }

  const imageUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
  const image = new Image();

  image.onload = () => {
    createCropEditor(container, image, imageUrl, user, onLogout);
  };

  image.onerror = () => {
    URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
    alert('Не удалось открыть эту фотографию.');
  };

  image.src = imageUrl;
}

function createCropEditor(container, image, imageUrl, user, onLogout) {
  const stageSize = 260;
  const baseScale = Math.max(
    stageSize / image.naturalWidth,
    stageSize / image.naturalHeight
  );

  let zoom = 1;
  let offsetX = 0;
  let offsetY = 0;
  let pointerX = 0;
  let pointerY = 0;
  let dragging = false;
  let saving = false;

  const overlay = document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className = 'avatar-editor-overlay';

  overlay.innerHTML = `
    <div class="avatar-editor" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="avatar-editor-title">
      <div class="avatar-editor-heading">
        <h2 id="avatar-editor-title">Настройка аватара</h2>
        <button class="avatar-editor-close" type="button"
          aria-label="Закрыть">×</button>
      </div>

      <div class="avatar-editor-stage">
        <img class="avatar-editor-image" alt="Предпросмотр аватара">
      </div>

      <p class="avatar-editor-hint">
        Перемещайте фото пальцем, чтобы выбрать нужную область
      </p>

      <label class="avatar-editor-zoom">
        <span>Масштаб</span>
        <input class="avatar-editor-range" type="range"
          min="1" max="3" step="0.01" value="1">
      </label>

      <p class="avatar-editor-error" aria-live="polite"></p>

      <div class="avatar-editor-actions">
        <button class="avatar-editor-cancel" type="button">Отмена</button>
        <button class="avatar-editor-save" type="button">Сохранить</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;

  container.appendChild(overlay);

  const stage = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-stage');
  const preview = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-image');
  const range = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-range');
  const saveButton = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-save');
  const errorText = overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-error');

  preview.src = image.src;

  function clampPosition() {
    const width = image.naturalWidth * baseScale * zoom;
    const height = image.naturalHeight * baseScale * zoom;

    const maxX = Math.max(0, (width - stageSize) / 2);
    const maxY = Math.max(0, (height - stageSize) / 2);

    offsetX = Math.max(-maxX, Math.min(maxX, offsetX));
    offsetY = Math.max(-maxY, Math.min(maxY, offsetY));
  }

  function updatePreview() {
    clampPosition();

    const width = image.naturalWidth * baseScale * zoom;
    const height = image.naturalHeight * baseScale * zoom;

    preview.style.width = `${width}px`;
    preview.style.height = `${height}px`;
    preview.style.transform =
      `translate(calc(-50% + ${offsetX}px), calc(-50% + ${offsetY}px))`;
  }

  function closeEditor() {
    if (saving) return;
    overlay.remove();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);
  }

  overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-close')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.querySelector('.avatar-editor-cancel')
    .addEventListener('click', closeEditor);

  overlay.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
    if (event.target === overlay) closeEditor();
  });

  range.addEventListener('input', () => {
    zoom = Number(range.value);
    updatePreview();
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
    dragging = true;
    pointerX = event.clientX;
    pointerY = event.clientY;
    stage.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
    if (!dragging) return;

    offsetX += event.clientX - pointerX;
    offsetY += event.clientY - pointerY;

    pointerX = event.clientX;
    pointerY = event.clientY;

    updatePreview();
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
    dragging = false;
  });

  stage.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
    dragging = false;
  });

  saveButton.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (saving) return;

    saving = true;
    saveButton.disabled = true;
    saveButton.textContent = 'Сохраняем...';
    errorText.textContent = '';

    try {
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      canvas.width = 512;
      canvas.height = 512;

      const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
      if (!context) throw new Error('Не удалось подготовить изображение');

      const factor = 512 / stageSize;
      const width = image.naturalWidth * baseScale * zoom * factor;
      const height = image.naturalHeight * baseScale * zoom * factor;
      const x = (stageSize / 2 + offsetX) * factor - width / 2;
      const y = (stageSize / 2 + offsetY) * factor - height / 2;

      context.drawImage(image, x, y, width, height);

      const blob = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        canvas.toBlob(
          result => result
            ? resolve(result)
            : reject(new Error('Не удалось обработать фотографию')),
          'image/jpeg',
          0.9
        );
      });

      const result = await uploadAvatar(blob);

      if (!result.avatar) {
        throw new Error('Сервер не вернул адрес аватара');
      }

      setUser({ ...user, avatar: result.avatar });
      overlay.remove();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(imageUrl);

      renderProfileScreen(container, { ...user, avatar: result.avatar },
        onLogout);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Rebunar: ошибка сохранения аватара:', error);
      errorText.textContent = error.message || 'Не удалось сохранить аватар';
      saving = false;
      saveButton.disabled = false;
      saveButton.textContent = 'Сохранить';
    }
  });

  updatePreview();
}

function escapeHTML(value) {
  return String(value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, character => ({
    '&': '&amp;',
    '<': '&lt;',
    '>': '&gt;',
    '"': '&quot;',
    "'": '&#039;'
  })[character]);
}

    <section class="screen settings-screen">

          </span>
          <span class="settings-item-content">
            <strong>Профиль</strong>
            <small>Личные данные, аватар и описание</small>
          </span>
          <span class="settings-arrow">›</span>
        </button>

        <button class="settings-item" type="button" data-action="security">
          <span class="settings-icon">◇</span>
          <span class="settings-item-content">
            <strong>Безопасность</strong>
            <small>Пароль и защита аккаунта</small>
          </span>
          <span class="settings-arrow">›</span>
        </button>

        <button class="settings-item" type="button" data-action="appearance">
          <span class="settings-icon">◐</span>
          <span class="settings-item-content">
            <strong>Оформление</strong>
            <small>Внешний вид Rebunar</small>
          </span>
          <span class="settings-arrow">›</span>
        </button>

        <button class="settings-item" type="button" data-route="statistics">
          <span class="settings-icon">▥</span>
          <span class="settings-item-content">
            <strong>Статистика Rebunar</strong>
            <small>Регистрации и активность платформы</small>
          </span>
          <span class="settings-arrow">›</span>
        </button>

      </div>
    </section>

  outlet.querySelector('[data-action="security"]')
    .addEventListener('click', () => {
